zh: 爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。
py: yé yé xiàn zài měi tiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ ， bù dàn jīng shén hǎo le ， shēn tǐ yě biàn jiàn kāng le 。
en: Grandpa's getting up early in the morning, and he's not only in good spirits but also in good health.

zh: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
py: dà wěi tǐng xǐ huān tā xiàn zài de gōng zuò ， bù dàn néng tiāo zhàn zì jǐ ， yě néng xué xí xīn de dōng xī 。
en: Great liked what he was doing, not only to challenge himself, but also to learn new things.

zh: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
py: xiǎo huáng yào qù biàn lì shāng diàn lǐng qián ，  wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kā fēi   lǎo bǎn qù ōu zhōu lǚ yóu huí lái ， mǎi le hé lán chuán tǒng de diǎn xīn sòng gěi dà jiā ， jiào wǒ men qù zhù lǐ nà lǐ lǐng 。
en: Wong is going to the convenience store to pick up the money, and I asked him to get me a cup of coffee from the owner of the br's trip to Europe, to buy you some Dutch-class snacks and to ask us to get them from the assistant.

zh: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
py: zhè dào cài néng gòu zhè me hǎo chī ， shì yīn wèi jiā le tè bié de jiàng liào ， hái yǒu zì jǐ zuò de jiàng yóu 。
en: It's so good because it's special sauce and it's made of soy sauce.

zh: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
py: nà jiā guǎng gào gōng sī tí gōng le wǔ gè gōng zuò jī huì ， zhǐ yào shì shè jì xì bì yè de dōu kě yǐ qù shì shì kàn 。
en: The advertising company offered five job opportunities, and anyone who graduated from the design department could try it.

zh: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
py: wǒ men xué xiào de lǐ táng kàn qǐ lái kōng jiān bù dà ， qí shí zuò dé xià yī qiān rén 。
en: The auditorium at our school doesn't look like much space, but it's got a thousand people sitting on it.

zh: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
py: xiǎo hán zǎo wǎn dōu dǎ gōng ， shì yīn wèi xiǎng duō cún yī xiē qián ， zǎo yī diǎn wán chéng chū guó niàn shū de mèng xiǎng 。
en: Sooner or later, Han worked because he wanted to save more money to complete his dream of going abroad.

zh: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
py: xiǎo ōu wèi le shěng qián ， zhěng gè yuè dōu chī pào miàn ， zuì hòu chī huài le shēn tǐ ， chī yào 、 zhù yuàn huā le gèng duō qián 。
en: In order to save money, he spent all month eating pasta and eventually eating his body, taking medication and spending more money in hospital.

zh: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
py: xiàn zài dà jiā dōu xí guàn yòng shǒu jī zhào xiàng ， yì bān de xiāng jī yǐ jīng yuè lái yuè shǎo rén shǐ yòng le 。
en: Now everyone's used to taking pictures on their phones, and the usual cameras are getting less and less used.

zh: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
py: wèi le jiā rén de jiàn kāng ， mā mā měi tiān dōu zǎo qǐ zhǔn bèi yíng yǎng fēng fù de zǎo cān ， ràng wǒ men yī tiān de kāi shǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīng shén 。
en: For the sake of the health of the family, mother wakes up early every day to prepare a rich breakfast, so that we can start with the spirit of the day.

zh: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
py: zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐ yù yòng pǐn de diàn ， zhǐ yào lái zhè lǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùn dòng xié 。
en: The entire street is a shop selling sports goods, and if you come here, you can buy the sports shoes you want.

zh: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
py: zhè gè chéng shì de kōng qì biàn qián jìng le ， zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi yǒu jié yùn yǐ hòu ， kāi chē de rén bǐ yǐ qián shǎo le 。
en: The city's air became clean, mainly because fewer people drove after the rapids.

zh: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
py: yīn wèi zuì jìn tài duō rén gǎn mào de guān xì ， lái shàng kè de tóng xué biàn shǎo le ， wǒ men bān bù guò shí gè rén ， jiù yǒu wǔ gè rén qǐng jiǎ  。
en: Since there are too many people in the cold these days, there have been fewer students coming to school. We have only 10 people in our class, and five people are on leave.

zh: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
py: zǎo shàng kāi chē qù shàng bān shí ， hū rán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lù kǒu pǎo chū lái ， bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào 。
en: When I drove to work in the morning, a dog came out of the road and scared me.

zh: A:小李怎麼還不來？等了半天， 我快餓死了。 B:算了，我們先吃吧，要不然菜涼了就不好吃了！
py: A: xiǎo lǐ zěn me hái bù lái ？ děng le bàn tiān ，  wǒ kuài è sǐ le 。 B: suàn le ， wǒ men xiān chī ba ， yào bù rán cài liáng le jiù bù hǎo chī le ！
en: A: Why isn't Xiao Li here? After half a day, I'm starving. B: Forget it, let's eat first, or it'll be bad if it's cold!

zh: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
py: guò nián huí jiā chī nián yè fàn ， dà jiā chī zhù chī zhù ， jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le ， měi hē jǐ bēi ， jiù chàng yī shǒu gē ， rè nào jí le 。
en: When people come home for their annual dinner, they drink wine, sing a song every time they drink. It's amazing.

zh: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
py: zài tái wān ， bù shǎo dà xué jiào shì lǐ de zhuō 、 yǐ shì lián zài yì qǐ de ， bān qǐ lái yǒu diǎn zhòng 。
en: In Taiwan, many of the tables and chairs in the university classrooms were connected and moved a little heavy.

zh: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
py: jīn tiān kāi huì shí ， jīng lǐ tí dào gōng sī dǎ suàn zuò shì chǎng yán jiū ， xī wàng dà jiā xià cì néng fā biǎo zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ 。
en: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned the company's intention to do market research and hoped that you would share your thoughts next time.

zh: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
py: duì wǒ lái shuō ， dōng tiān de lè qù jiù shì dài zhù hòu hòu de shǒu tào ， hé péng yǒu wán xuě qiú 。
en: For me, winter's fun is to wear thick gloves and play snowball with friends.

zh: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
py: gōng sī jìn le gè shì gè yàng de jiàn shēn jī qì ，  wǒ men dé hǎo hǎo lì yòng zhè xiē jī qì ， xùn liàn zì jǐ de tǐ lì   měi měi gāng jìn mó tè ér gōng sī shí ， yǒu yī wèi dǎo yǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì ， méi xiǎng dào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒu míng de míng xīng 。
en: The company's access to a variety of gymnasium machines, and we need to use them to train our own strength <br' a new model, and a director came to her and made her a famous star.

zh: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
py: nà jiā chāo shì de shēng yì fēi cháng hǎo ， yīn wèi tā men jìn le hěn duō tè bié de líng shí ， dà rén 、 xiǎo hái dōu xiǎng cháng cháng kàn 。
en: The supermarket was very good because they were in a lot of special snacks, and adults and kids wanted to try it.

zh: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
py: xiǎo jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōng sī zì wǒ tuī jiàn ， jīng guò le jǐ gè yuè ， zuì hòu zhǎo dào le mǎn yì de gōng zuò   jīng guò gēn fù mǔ de tǎo lùn ， dà zhōng jué dìng xiān chū guó yóu xué yī nián ， zài huí lái niàn dà xué 。
en: After a few months of self-recognizing to many companies, Jane finally found a happy job, after discussions with his parents, decided to go abroad for a year and go back to college.

zh: 那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。
py: nà gè rén kàn qǐ lái hěn shén mì ， dà jiā dōu bù zhī dào tā cóng nǎ lǐ lái 、 zuò shén me gōng zuò 。
en: The man looks mysterious, and no one knows where he comes from or what he does.

zh: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
py: yé yé qù guò ā lǐ shān hǎo jǐ huí ， měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bù tóng de fēng jǐng ， tā shuō fēi cháng zhí de 。
en: Grandpa's been to Mount Ali several times, and he sees different scenes every time, and he says it's worth it.

zh: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
py: jiù jiù duì wǒ hěn hǎo ， bù guǎn wǒ yù dào shén me tiāo zhàn ， zhǐ yào gēn tā shuō yī shēng ， tā yí dìng huì bāng máng 。
en: Uncle's been nice to me, no matter what challenge I've encountered, just tell him he'll help.

zh: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
py: tái wān yì bān jiù gōng yù de fáng zi dà yuē sān shí duō píng ， yǒu kè tīng 、 chú fáng 、 yī jiān yù shì hé sān jiān wò fáng 。
en: The houses in the old apartment in Taiwan are approximately 30 pedals, with a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and three bedrooms.

zh: 這個城市的公車司機不找錢，要是你沒有公車卡，就得自己準備零錢。
py: zhè gè chéng shì de gōng chē sī jī bù zhǎo qián ， yào shì nǐ méi yǒu gōng chē kǎ ， jiù dé zì jǐ zhǔn bèi líng qián 。
en: The bus driver in this city doesn't look for money. If you don't have a bus card, you have to make your own change.

zh: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
py: shèng xià de fàn cài jiā rè tài duō cì ， jiù méi shén me yíng yǎng le ， zuì hǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng 。
en: The rest of the food is too hot to feed. It's better to eat every meal.

zh: 昨天小康碰到一位好久不見的老朋友，他們聊天聊到很晚才回家。
py: zuó tiān xiǎo kāng pèng dào yī wèi hǎo jiǔ bù jiàn de lǎo péng yǒu ， tā men liáo tiān liáo dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā 。
en: Yesterday, Kang met an old friend who had been missing for a long time and who had been chatting until very late to come home.

zh: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
py: dà rén yīng gāi bǎ dāo zi fàng zài ān quán de dì fāng ， yào bù rán xiǎo hái zi pèng le ， kě néng huì shòu shāng 。
en: The adults should put the knife in a safe place, otherwise the children might get hurt.

zh: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
py: nà wèi fú wù shēng bù xiào de shí hòu ， yàng zi kàn qǐ lái hěn xiōng ， qí shí tā duì kè rén de tài dù hěn hǎo 。
en: When the waiter didn't laugh, he looked mean, but he was very nice to the guests.

zh: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
py: qián lǎo bǎn mǎn nǎo zi dōu shì gōng zuò ， měi tiān zhǐ xiǎng zhù zěn me ràng gōng sī chéng zhǎng dé kuài yī diǎn 。
en: The money boss is working, and every day he just wants to make the company grow a little faster.

zh: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
py: wài guó xué shēng yī kāi shǐ xué xiě hàn zì de sù dù bǐ jiào màn ， zhǐ yào duō liàn xí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le 。
en: Foreign students are slow to learn to write Chinese at the beginning, and they can write as fast as they can with more practice.

zh: 如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
py: rú guǒ zhǐ zhù yì bié rén de quē diǎn ， jiù yǒng yuǎn kàn bú dào tā men de yōu diǎn le 。
en: If only attention is paid to other people's shortcomings, their merits will never be seen.

zh: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
py: mā mā duì gē gē shuō ， yǐ tā xiàn zài gāng shàng bān de qíng kuàng ， bù néng jí zhù mǎi fáng zi ， dé děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi 。
en: My mother told my brother that when he's just at work, he can't wait to buy a house until he's saved enough money.

zh: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
py: nǐ huí jiā jīng guò mài hán guó huò de chāo shì shí ， kě yǐ shùn biàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pào miàn ma ？
en: Can you buy me two buns of bread while you're at the Korean supermarket?

zh: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
py: xiǎo yuán zuó tiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bā qiān yuán de dà yī ， méi xiǎng dào nà jiā fú zhuāng diàn jīn tiān dǎ sān zhé ， tā tài chī kuī le 。
en: Xiao Yuan just bought an $8,000 coat yesterday, but I didn't think he had a 30 per cent discount on the dress shop today.

zh: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
py: wèi le cān jiā tóng shì de hūn lǐ ， wǒ dǎ suàn dāng tiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tè sè de zhōng guó chuán tǒng fú zhuāng 。
en: In order to attend a colleague's wedding, I intend to wear a special Chinese traditional dress that day.

zh: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
py: xiàng tī zú qiú nà yàng de yùn dòng ， duì nián jì dà de rén bù tài hé shì 。
en: Sports like football are not suitable for older people.

zh: 小文為了得到超商送的小禮物，每天都特地去那裡買咖啡、三明治。
py: xiǎo wén wèi liǎo de dào chāo shāng sòng de xiǎo lǐ wù ， měi tiān dōu tè dì qù nà lǐ mǎi kā fēi 、 sān míng zhì 。
en: Wen went there every day to buy coffee and sandwiches in order to get a little gift from the supermarket.

zh: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié de shè jì hěn tè bié ， zài bǎi huò gōng sī de zhuān guì cái mǎi dé dào 。
en: The pair of sneakers was designed in a very special way, only to be bought in the department store cabinet.

zh: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
py: nà wèi dà míng xīng shēn shàng chuān de 、 shǒu shàng dài de  ， dōu shì yǒu míng de pái zi   jīng lǐ zuò shì tài dù rèn zhēn 、 fù zé ， wǒ cóng tā shēn shàng xué dào le hěn duō zuò rén zuò shì de dào lǐ 。
en: I've learned a lot from that big star who wears all the things he wears in his hands, and all the things he's known as the manager of br, who's serious and responsible.

zh: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
py: xiǎo lǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái bǐ jiào shòu ， kě néng shì yīn wèi chuān le shēn sè yī fú de guān xì   wǒ mèi mèi gāng xué huì yóu yǒng ， jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dì fāng ， wǒ jué dé tài wēi xiǎn le 。
en: Li looks thin today, probably because of the dark-coloured relationship my sister just learned to swim and want to swim deep in the water, which I think is too dangerous.

zh: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
py: lǐ xiǎo jiě de wài yǔ néng lì hěn qiáng ， yě zài ōu zhōu gōng zuò guò ， wǒ jué dé zhè gè fān yì gōng zuò hěn shì hé tā 。
en: Ms. Lee has a strong foreign language skills and has worked in Europe, and I think this translation is very suitable for her.

zh: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
py: zhōu xiān shēng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēn pí zuò de shā fā ， zuò qǐ lái hěn shū fú 。
en: Mr. Chow bought a real-skin couch, and it was comfortable sitting up.

zh: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
py: jīn xiǎo jiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎn sè de shàng yī ，  kàn qǐ lái gèng nián qīng 、 gèng yǒu jīng shén le   zhè gè yī guì yǒu diǎn ér qiǎn ， zhè jiàn hòu dà yī guà bù jìn qù ， jiù suàn guà jìn qù le ，  mén yě guān bù qǐ lái 。
en: Ms. King, in this lightly-coloured top, looks younger and more spiritual, and this closet is a little light, and this thick coat can't hang in, and the door can't close.

zh: 雖然小馬的個子不高，不過籃球打得可好了。
py: suī rán xiǎo mǎ de gè zi bù gāo ， bù guò lán qiú dǎ dé kě hǎo le 。
en: Although the ponies are not tall, basketball plays well.

zh: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
py: kè rén ： zhè shuāng pí xié wǒ chuān qǐ lái tài jǐn le ，  kě yǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yī diǎn de ma ？  diàn yuán ： méi wèn tí ， wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de 。
en: Guest: I'm wearing these leather shoes too tight for a bigger one. Shopkeeper: No problem, I'll get you a bigger one.

zh: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
py: zhè jiā zhuān guì de diàn yuán bǐ gāng cái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng ， nán guài shēng yì zhè me chà 。
en: The clerk of this store is worse than the other one, so that's why business is so bad.

zh: 最近很多人感冒了，不過不必太擔心，只要戴上口罩、別去人多的地方就行了。
py: zuì jìn hěn duō rén gǎn mào le ， bù guò bù bì tài dān xīn ， zhǐ yào dài shàng kǒu zhào 、 bié qù rén duō de dì fāng jiù xíng le 。
en: A lot of people have had a cold recently, but don't worry about it. Just put on a mask and stay away from the crowd.

zh: 陳小姐今天穿了一件跟我相同牌子的洋裝，還好顏色不同。
py: chén xiǎo jiě jīn tiān chuān le yī jiàn gēn wǒ xiāng tóng pái zi de yáng zhuāng ， hái hǎo yán sè bù tóng 。
en: Ms. Chen is wearing a dress just like mine today, but it's not the same color.

zh: 他們特地穿上情侶裝出門，好像要告訴大家他們是幸福的情侶。
py: tā men tè dì chuān shàng qíng lǚ zhuāng chū mén ， hǎo xiàng yào gào sù dà jiā tā men shì xìng fú de qíng lǚ 。
en: And they go forth in a special dress as if they were happy couples.

zh: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
py: zài wǒ yé yé nǎi nǎi de nián dài ， shēng huó bǐ jiào xīn kǔ ， bù shǎo qióng rén wèi le shěng qián ， yī fú pò le hái shì jì xù chuān 。
en: During my grandparents' years, life was harder for poor people to save money, but their clothes were broken or they kept wearing them.

zh: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
py: shì yǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wà zi rēng zài dì shàng ， xī wàng tā néng bǎ zhè gè huài xí guàn gǎi diào 。
en: The roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor, hoping he can change his bad habits.

zh: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
py: dōng tiān yī dào ， wǒ de pí fū jiù biàn dé hěn qián ， suǒ yǐ dé zhù yì bǎo yǎng 。
en: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to keep an eye on it.

zh: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
py: xiǎo lóng shòu bù liǎo zài nà gè yòu rè yòu zāng de gōng chǎng gōng zuò ， zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù lí kāi le 。
en: Dragon couldn't stand working in that hot, dirty factory and left for only three days.

zh: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
py: xiǎo lán shén me dōu bù pà ， jiù shì pà gēn nǚ shēng shuō huà ， zhǐ yào yī shuō huà ， tā de liǎn jiù hóng le 。
en: Blue is afraid of anything but talking to a girl, and his face is red as soon as he talks.

zh: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
py: měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de yōu diǎn ， bù xū yào qiáng diào ， yě bù bì gēn bié rén bǐ lái bǐ qù 。
en: Each person has his or her own merits, and there is no need to stress them, nor to compare them with others.

zh: 買襯衫的時候得注意肩膀的大小，太大或太小都不合適。
py: mǎi chèn shān de shí hòu dé zhù yì jiān bǎng de dà xiǎo ， tài dà huò tài xiǎo dōu bù hé shì 。
en: When buying shirts, care must be taken of the size of the shoulder, which is too big or too small to fit.

zh: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
py: wǒ mā mā hěn huì bǎo yǎng ， kàn qǐ lái yòu nián qīng yòu piào liàng ， hěn duō rén dōu yǐ wèi wǒ men shì zǐ mèi 。
en: My mother is very well-protected, looks young and pretty, and a lot of people think we're sisters.

zh: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
py: xiǎng yào xī yǐn gù kè lái gòu mǎi jià gé gāo de shāng pǐn ， chú le pǐn zhì hǎo ， fú wù tài dù yě hěn zhòng yào 。
en: In addition to being of good quality, a service attitude is also important if customers are to be attracted to buy high-priced goods.

zh: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
py: yī shēng shuō nà gè bìng rén dé zhù yuàn ， yào shì sān tiān yǐ nèi dōu méi fā shāo 、 tóu yě bù tòng le ， jiù kě yǐ chū yuàn le 。
en: The doctor said that the patient had to be hospitalized and could be discharged if he had no fever and no headaches in three days.

zh: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
py: zhāng xiān shēng cháng bāng tài tài mǎi cài 、 xǐ yī fú ，  yào shì bǐ tài tài zǎo xià bān ， hái huì bǎ wǎn cān zuò hǎo ， zhēn tǐ tiē   wǒ tóng xué hěn tǐ tiē fù mǔ ， jīng cháng zhǔ fàn 、  zuò jiā shì ， bāng le fù mǔ bù shǎo máng 。
en: Mr. Zhang used to buy food and laundry for his wife, and if she left early, she would have finished dinner.

zh: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
py: wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎo kè lì bǐng qián ， yòng hǎo kàn de zhǐ bāo le yī xiē sòng gěi lín jū 。
en: I baked a lot of chocolate biscuits and packed some of them with nice paper for the neighbors.

zh: 你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
py: nǐ xiān bié jí zhù mǎi ， huò bǐ sān jiā bù chī kuī ， duō kàn jǐ jiā zài jué dìng ba ！
en: Don't worry about it. We'll decide if we're going to lose more than we are.

zh: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
py: nà sān jiā shāng diàn dōu mài xiāng tóng pái zi de pí bāo ， wǒ men zuì hǎo xiān bǐ gè jià ， zài jué dìng mǎi nǎ yī jiā de 。
en: All three stores sell the same handbags, and we'd better get a price and decide which one to buy.

zh: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
py: wǒ xǐ huān zài wǎng lù shāng diàn gòu wù ， chú le néng shěng bù shǎo shí jiān ， hái kě yǐ bǎ shāng pǐn sòng dào jiā 。
en: I like shopping in Internet shops, and besides saving a lot of time, I can get the goods home.

zh: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng bù jǐn fú wù tài dù hǎo ， ér qiě shí wù hǎo chī yòu pián yi ， nán guài dà jiā dōu tuī jiàn wǒ lái cháng cháng 。
en: This restaurant is not only service-friendly, but it's good food and cheap, so that's why I'm recommended.

zh: 我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。
py: wǒ bù rèn wèi dì tān méi hǎo huò ， yǒu yī xiē dì tān de dōng xī bù jǐn jià gé pián yi ， pǐn zhì yě bù cuò 。
en: I don't think there's a good deal going on, and there's something that's not just cheap, it's good in quality.

zh: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
py: zhè lǐ de měi yī yàng chǎn pǐn dōu shì lǎo bǎn zì jǐ shè jì de ， bié de dì fāng zhǎo bú dào xiāng tóng de 。
en: Every product here is designed by the boss himself, and it cannot be found anywhere else.

zh: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
py: hé xiǎo jiě xí guàn qù chuán tǒng shì chǎng mǎi shuǐ guǒ ， ér qiě dōu gēn tóng yī gè tān fàn mǎi 。
en: Miss Ho is used to buying fruit from the traditional market and also from the same dealer.

zh: 購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。
py: gòu wù shí wǒ xǐ huān yī gè rén màn màn kàn ， bù tài xǐ huān diàn yuán yì zhí xiàng wǒ tuī xiāo 。
en: I like to be alone when I go shopping. I don't like shopkeepers selling me all the time.

zh: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
py: chāo shāng cháng jǔ bàn sòng xiǎo lǐ wù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huó dòng ， kě shì duì wáng xiān shēng wán quán méi yǒu xī yǐn lì 。
en: Supermarkets often offer small gifts or buy one, but they are totally unattractive to Mr. Wang.

zh: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
py: xiǎo gāo zǒng shì zài bié rén miàn qián biǎo xiàn dé hěn yǒu lǐ mào ， bù guò huí dào jiā jiù wán quán biàn le yī gè yàng zi 。
en: Ko always behaved politely in front of others, but when he came home, he completely changed.

zh: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
py: lǐ lǎo bǎn shì gè hěn shí zài de rén ， tā mài de bāo zi bù dàn hǎo chī ， xiàn liào （xiànliào， filling） yě hěn shí zài ， nán guài shēng yì hǎo dé bù dé le   jīn tiān tiān qì shí zài tài rè le ， suī rán xià tiān de diàn fèi hěn guì ， wǒ hái shì bǎ lěng qì dǎ kāi le 。
en: Mr. Lee is a real man, and not only does he sell the buns, but he sells the stuff. No wonder the business is too hot today, even though the electricity is expensive in the summer, I turn on the air.

zh: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
py: lái lái lái ， kuài lái mǎi ！ wǒ men 3C chǎn pǐn de jià gé zuì yōu huì ， pǐn zhì yě hěn hǎo ， kuài bǎ wò jī huì ō ！
en: Come on, buy it! Our 3C product is the best price, and it's of good quality. Take the chance!

zh: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
py: yé yé zài zhè dòng gōng yù zhù le shí nián le ， bān jiā shí ， yòng le hǎo jǐ gè dà xiāng zi lái zhuāng dōng xī 。
en: Grandpa's been living in this apartment for 10 years, and when he moved, he used several large boxes to load things.

zh: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
py: zhè suǒ dà xué yǒu zuì xīn de diàn nǎo shè bèi ， tí gōng xué shēng hěn hǎo de xué xí huán jìng 。
en: The university has the latest computer equipment that provides students with a good learning environment.

zh: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
py: nà jiā gōng chǎng shēng chǎn de pí xié 、 pí dài ， bù dàn pǐn zhì hǎo ， jià qián yě bù guì 。
en: The leather shoes and belts produced by the factory were not only of good quality but were not expensive.

zh: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
py: yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎn zé shàng wǎng gòu wù ， yǒu de shì wèi le jié shěng shí jiān ， yǒu de shì yīn wèi bǐ jià hěn fāng biàn 。
en: More and more people are shopping online, either to save time or because the price is easy.

zh: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
py: jīng lǐ zhè cì yuàn yì cǎi yòng xīn yuán gōng de jiàn yì ， ràng wǒ men dōu xià le yī tiào 。
en: The manager's offer to take the advice of the new staff gave us a shock.

zh: 這首歌很受歡迎，被認為是今年的最佳歌曲。
py: zhè shǒu gē hěn shòu huān yíng ， bèi rèn wèi shì jīn nián de zuì jiā gē qǔ 。
en: This song is very popular and is considered the best song of the year.

zh: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
py: bāo xiǎo jiě de yǎn guāng hěn hǎo ， yī kàn jiù zhī dào nà jiàn huáng sè wài tào de pǐn zhì zuì hǎo   mèi mèi ： wǒ xī wàng jiāng lái zhǎo gè yòu cōng míng yòu yǒu qián  ， ér qiě hěn tǐ tiē wǒ de nán péng yǒu 。  zǐ zǐ ： nǐ de yǎn guāng tài gāo le ， kǒng pà zhǎo bú dào 。
en: Miss Bao has a very good eye, and she knows that the yellow jacket is the best quality   sister: I hope to find a smart, rich, and considerate boyfriend. Sister: Your eyes are too high, I'm afraid you can't find them.

zh: 小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。
py: xiǎo lán kàn qǐ lái hú lǐ hú tú de ， qí shí zuò qǐ shì lái zǎi xì dé hěn 。
en: Blue looks confused, but she does things very carefully.

zh: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
py: zài tái wān ， hái zi chū shēng mǎn yī gè yuè de shí hòu ， yǒu de fù mǔ huì qǐng kè ， qìng zhù hái zi mǎn yuè 。
en: In Taiwan, when a child is born for a month, some parents invite customers to celebrate the child ' s full moon.

zh: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
py: nà duì shuāng bāo tāi jiě mèi bù dàn zhǎng dé hěn xiàng ， lián xìng gé yě yī yàng kāi lǎng 、 dà fāng 。
en: The twins were not only very alike, they were as open and generous as they were.

zh: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
py: nà suǒ shuāng yǔ xué xiào qiáng diào ， chú le zhōng wén kè yǐ wài ， qí tā de kè chéng dōu shì yòng yīng wén shàng de 。
en: The two-language school stressed that all classes except Chinese were in English.

zh: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
py: tā suī rán nián jì xiǎo ， dàn shì duì rén yǒu lǐ mào ， yě hěn tǐ tiē fù mǔ ， shì gè guāi hái zi 。
en: He was young, but polite and kind to his parents and a good boy.

zh: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
py: yǒu rén shuō ， shēng hái zi róng yì ， yǎng xiǎo hái nán ， nǐ jué dé ne ？
en: Some say it's easy to have a child. It's hard to raise a child, don't you think?

zh: 這是我爺爺抱著我的照片，那時候我才一歲呢！
py: zhè shì wǒ yé yé bào zhù wǒ de zhào piān ， nà shí hòu wǒ cái yī suì ne ！
en: Here's a picture of my grandfather holding me. I was only a year old then!

zh: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
py: zhāng tài tài shàng gè yuè shēng le yī gè nǚ ér ， wǒ xiě le yī zhāng kǎ piàn zhù fú tā ， xī wàng hái zi kuài kuài lè lè dì zhǎng dà 。  wǒ de hái zi mǎn yuè shí ， shōu dào hěn duō péng yǒu sòng de lǐ wù hé mǎn mǎn de zhù fú 。
en: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month, and I wrote a card to bless her, hoping that the child would grow up happy and happy. When my child was full, he received gifts and full blessing from a lot of friends.

zh: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
py: chú xī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fù mǔ yī wàn kuài de hóng bāo ， zhù fú tā men xīn nián kuài lè ， dà jí dà lì ！
en: I gave my parents 10,000 red bags on New Year's Eve to wish them a happy New Year.

zh: 華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。
py: huá rén xǐ huān xiàng èr 、 liù 、 bā de shù zì ， zhè jǐ gè shù zì dōu shì shuāng shù ， yǒu hěn duō hǎo shì yì qǐ lái de yì si 。
en: The Chinese like numbers like two, six, eight, which are even, and have a lot of good things to do together.

zh: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
py: duì bù qǐ ！ wǒ zuó tiān gēn nǐ shuō huà de tài dù bù hǎo ， wǒ xiàng nǐ dào qiàn ， qǐng nǐ bié shēng qì le 。
en: I'm sorry. I wasn't very nice talking to you yesterday. I apologize to you. Please don't be angry.

zh: 尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。
py: shàng ēn shì jiā háo de hǎo péng yǒu ， fēi cháng qīng chǔ tā de gè xìng ， lián tā xǐ huān chī shén me dōu hěn qīng chǔ 。
en: Sean is a good friend of Hao's, and he knows his personality very well, even what he likes to eat.

zh: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
py: zhè liǎng bù bǐ diàn de gōng néng chà yì bù dà ， jiù shì jià qián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài 。
en: The two laptops are not so different in their functionality, but they cost hundreds of dollars.

zh: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
py: péng yǒu de hái zi mǎn yuè le ， wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yī fèn lǐ ， zhù fú tā píng píng ān ān dì zhǎng dà 。
en: The child of a friend is full of moons, and I would like to give him a gift and wish him well and well.

zh: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
py: wèi le bì miǎn pí fū shòu shāng ， xià tiān chū mén shí bié wàng le dài shàng mào zi hé tài yáng yǎn jìng 。
en: In order to avoid skin injury, don't forget to wear hats and sunglasses when you leave the house in the summer.

zh: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
py: zhāng xiān shēng yì zhí xiǎng dāng lǜ shī ， jīng guò duō nián de nǔ lì ， zhōng yú mèng xiǎng chéng zhēn le 。
en: Mr. Jang has always wanted to be a lawyer, and after years of work, his dream has come true.

zh: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
py: nà liǎng jiā biàn lì shāng diàn tóng yàng tí gōng kè rén xiū xī de zuò wèi ， dàn shì dì èr jiā de kōng jiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le   lín mā mā zǒng shì gěi tā de shuāng bāo tāi nǚ ér chuān tóng yàng yán sè 、 tóng yàng dà xiǎo de yī fú 。
en: The two convenience stores also offer guest rest seats, but the second room is much more than the first one, and `br' Lin's mother always wears the same color and size of clothes for her twin daughter.

zh: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
py: wǒ jiù jiù zài gōng sī de biǎo xiàn yàng yàng dōu hǎo ， suǒ yǐ lǎo bǎn dǎ suàn míng nián ràng tā dāng jīng lǐ 。
en: My uncle behaved well at the company, so the boss wants him to be the manager next year.

zh: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
py: wǒ hé péng yǒu dào cān tīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài ， zuì hòu méi chī wán ， zhǐ hǎo dǎ bāo huí jiā 。
en: My friends and I ordered a lot of food in the restaurant, and we didn't finish it, so we had to pack up and go home.

zh: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
py: wǒ yì zhí xiǎng dào ōu zhōu qù lǚ xíng ， zhǐ shì xiàn zài máng dé méi shí jiān qù ， xī wàng míng nián néng mèng xiǎng chéng zhēn 。
en: I've been thinking about going to Europe, but I'm just too busy to go, hoping that next year's dream will come true.

zh: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
py: lǐ xiān shēng cóng bù chī pào miàn 、 shǔ tiáo 、 rè gǒu nà yàng de shí wù ， yīn wèi tā jué dé bù jiàn kāng 。
en: Mr. Lee never eats food like noodles, fries, hot dogs, because he feels unhealthy.

zh: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
py: zhào huá rén de chuán tǒng xí guàn ， nǚ rén shēng wán hái zi jiù yào zuò yuè zi ， yì zhí zài jiā xiū xī dào hái zi mǎn yuè 。
en: According to the Chinese tradition, a woman has to sit on the moon after giving birth, resting at home until the child is full in the moon.

zh: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
py: mǔ qīn jié nà tiān ， wǒ qīn zì zuò le yī gè dà dàn gāo ， sòng gěi zuì qīn ài de mā mā 。
en: On Mother's Day, I made myself a big cake for my dearest mother.

zh: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
py: jiù yào kāi huì le ， kě shì wǒ tóng shì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎn pǐn de shuō míng zī liào zhǔn bèi hǎo ， zhēn jiào rén jǐn zhāng 。
en: The meeting's about to begin, but my colleague hasn't prepared the instructions for the new product.

zh: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
py: wǒ gē gē kāi lǎng huó pō 、 gāo dà yīng jùn ， nán guài yǒu hěn duō nǚ shēng zhuī qiú tā 。
en: My brother was very active and tall and handsome, and no wonder there were a lot of girls after him.

zh: 假日我常跟家人一塊兒去郊區爬山、野餐。
py: jià rì wǒ cháng gēn jiā rén yī kuài ér qù jiāo qū pá shān 、 yě cān 。
en: I used to go to the suburbs to climb mountains and picnics with my family on holidays.

zh: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shàng zuò le yī gè mèng ， mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐ huān de míng xīng yī tóng yǎn xì ， kāi xīn dé bù dé le 。
en: I had a dream last night that I was so happy to play with my favorite star.

zh: 多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。
py: duō yuè dú shū bào 、 zá zhì ， néng ràng wǒ men de zhī shí gèng fēng fù 。
en: Read more books, magazines, and make our knowledge better.

zh: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
py: rèn hé rén dōu yīng gāi rèn zhēn sī kǎo zì jǐ de wèi lái ， bié hú lǐ hú tú dì guò rì zi 。
en: It is up to anyone to think seriously about his future and not to live in obscurity.

zh: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
py: fù qián de shí hòu ， tā cóng pí bāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìn yòng kǎ jiāo gěi diàn yuán   tā cān jiā bǎi huò gōng sī de huó dòng ， chōu dào yī tái jià gé liù wàn yuán de píng bǎn diàn nǎo ，  zhēn shì tài xìng yùn le ！
en: When he paid for it, he took a credit card out of his bag to the storeman   and he took a $60,000 flat-plate computer!

zh: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
py: bù guǎn zhuī qiú mèng xiǎng de lù shàng yǒu duō xīn kǔ ， dōu shì wǒ men yī bèi zi zhēn guì de huí yì 。
en: No matter how hard it is to pursue a dream, it is a precious memory for us all our lives.

zh: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
py: tīng shuō zuò yuè zi shí bù néng xǐ tóu fà ， yào bù rán duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo ， nǐ xiāng xìn zhè yàng de shuō fǎ ma ？
en: I heard you can't wash your hair while you're sitting there, or it's bad for your health. Do you believe that?

zh: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
py: wǒ de qián bāo diū le ， lǐ miàn yǒu hù zhào 、  xìn yòng kǎ ， zhè jiàn shì hěn yào jǐn ， dé mǎ shàng gào sù jǐng chá  A: nǐ zěn me yì zhí ké sòu ？ yào bù yào qù kàn yī shēng ？ B: bú yào jǐn ， wǒ chī guò yào le ， xiū xī yī xià jiù hǎo le 。
en: I've lost my wallet, I've got passports, credit cards, and it's very important to tell the police: "br"A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's okay, I've taken my medicine. Just take a break.

zh: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
py: yán tài tài hěn huì bǎo yǎng ， mǔ zi liǎng rén zhàn zài yì qǐ shí ， kàn qǐ lái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐ dì 。
en: Mrs. Yan is a good keeper. When the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of sisters.

zh: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
py: wǒ jué dé zhù zài xiāng xià chú le gòu wù bù fāng biàn yǐ wài ， shén me dōu hǎo   wǒ de fáng dōng zhǐ tí gōng jiā jù 、 diàn shì hé bīng xiāng ， yǐ wài de dōng xī tā bù guǎn 。
en: I think living in the country, except for the inconvenience of shopping, my landlord only provides furniture, TV and refrigerators, and he doesn't care about anything else.

zh: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
py: zhōu mò wǒ dài hái zi men qù xiāng xià wán ， tā men wèi xiǎo yáng chī cǎo ， ná mán tóu gěi hóu zi chī ， wán dé hěn kāi xīn 。
en: I took the kids to the country on the weekends, and they fed the sheep grass, gave the goats grafts to the monkeys and had fun.

zh: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
py: huáng jiào shòu bù jǐn zhī shí fēng fù 、 shàng kè rèn zhēn ， hái hěn guān xīn xué shēng ， dà jiā dōu hěn zūn jìng tā 。
en: Professor Huang is not only knowledgeable and serious, he is also concerned about students and everyone respects him.

zh: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
py: xiǎo chén hěn xiào shùn ， měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù ān yǎng yuàn péi fù qīn liáo tiān 、 sàn bù ， yī diǎn ér dōu bù jué dé xīn kǔ   xiào shùn fù mǔ de fāng fǎ hěn duō ， zuì jiǎn dān de jiù shì bù ràng tā men dān xīn 、 shēng qì 。
en: Chen is kind enough to go to a nursing home every weekend to chat with his father and walk without feeling that it is difficult and easy to do good with his parents. The simplest thing is to keep them from worrying and angry.

zh: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
py: huá rén zài chú xī nà tiān ， dōu huì gēn qīn rén jù zài yì qǐ chī nián yè fàn 、 gěi hóng bāo ， hù xiāng gōng xǐ xīn nián hǎo 。
en: And on the day of New Year's Eve, the people of the city will meet with their relatives to eat their annual dinner and give each other a red bag to congratulate each other on the New Year.

zh: 每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
py: měi nián chūn jié shí ， bà bà dōu huì sòng gé bì lín jū yī hé píng guǒ ， zhù tā men měi tiān dōu píng ān 、 rú yì 。
en: Every spring, Dad sends a box of apples to his neighbours, wishing them every day peace and happiness.

zh: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
py: wǒ qù cān jiā péng yǒu de hūn lǐ ， chú le sòng hóng bāo ， hái zhù fú tā men shì shì rú yì 、 zǎo shēng guì zi 、 yǒng yuǎn xìng fú 。
en: I went to a friend's wedding and, in addition to delivering a red bag, wished them well in their lives, early in their lives and eternal happiness.

zh: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
py: dì zhèn shí yào bǎo hù zì jǐ de ān quán ， zuì zhòng yào de shì bì miǎn tóu bù shòu shāng   dāng dì zhèn fā shēng shí ， wǒ men yīng gāi zěn me zuò ne ？
en: What are we supposed to do when an earthquake takes place in order to protect ourselves from head injury?

zh: 新聞報告說颱風快來了，出門時得注意安全。
py: xīn wén bào gào shuō tái fēng kuài lái le ， chū mén shí dé zhù yì ān quán 。
en: The news reports say the hurricane is coming, and we need to be safe when we go out.

zh: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
py: qiáng liè de yáng guāng duì wǒ men de yǎn jīng bù hǎo ， chū mén huó dòng shí zuì hǎo dài shàng tài yáng yǎn jìng 。
en: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes, and it's best to wear sunglasses when going out.

zh: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
py: nà liàng qì chē tū rán cóng lù kǒu kāi le chū lái ，  bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào   tīng shuō jīng lǐ hòu tiān jiù yào lí kāi gōng sī le 。  zhè gè xiāo xī tài tū rán le ， dà jiā yī shí méi bàn fǎ jiē shòu 。
en: The car suddenly came out of the street, scared me the day after I heard the manager was leaving the company, and the news was so sudden that everybody couldn't accept it.

zh: 這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。
py: zhè gè shè qū de zhōu wéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ ， kōng qì yě hěn hǎo ， zhè yàng de shēng huó huán jìng hěn shì hé tuì xiū de rén 。
en: The community is surrounded by mountains and water, and the air is good, and this is a suitable environment for retired people.

zh: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
py: nà wèi lǎo xiān shēng zǒu zhù zǒu zhù ， lù páng de shù mù tū rán dào le xià lái ， tā chà yī diǎn jiù shòu shāng le 。
en: The old man was walking, and the trees on the side of the road suddenly fell, and he almost got hurt.

zh: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
py: nà gè dì qū zuó tiān yè lǐ tū rán tíng shuǐ 、 tíng diàn ， hái hǎo jīn tiān zhōng wǔ jiù huī fù zhèng cháng le 。
en: The area was suddenly out of water and power last night, but it's good that it's back to normal at noon today.

zh: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
py: xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dà yǔ ， bù dàn dào chù yān shuǐ ， lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī 、 yā yě yān sǐ le 。
en: After several days of heavy rains, not only was there flooding, but even the chickens and ducks that my family had raised drowned.

zh: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
py: wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi ， cóng bù pò huài jiā lǐ de dōng xī   tái fēng kuài lái le ， pò huài le wǒ běn lái yào qù lù yíng de jì huà 。
en: My dog was a good boy, and the storm never destroyed the family's things, and it ruined my plan to go camping.

zh: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
py: kǒng xiān shēng hěn zhòng shì shēng huó pǐn zhì ， yě hěn xǐ huān zuò jiā shì ， suǒ yǐ zǒng shì bǎ jiā lǐ zhěng lǐ dé qián qián jìng jìng de 。
en: Mr. Kong, who valued the quality of his life and liked to do family work, kept the house clean.

zh: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
py: zhè gè dì qū bèi tái fēng pò huài dé xiāng dāng yán zhòng ， bú shì shù mù dào le ， jiù shì wū dǐng bèi chuī zǒu le ， qíng kuàng fēi cháng zāo gāo 。
en: The area was severely damaged by the hurricane, either by the fall of trees or by the blowout of the roof, which was very bad.

zh: 糟了！衣服被咖啡弄髒了，我得換一件才能出門。
py: zāo le ！ yī fú bèi kā fēi nòng zāng le ， wǒ dé huàn yī jiàn cái néng chū mén 。
en: Oh, no! The coffee's dirty. I've got to change to get out of the house.

zh: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
py: yīn wèi tíng diàn le ， xiǎng yào zhī dào tái fēng de xiāo xī ， zhǐ néng tīng shōu yīn jī de guǎng bō   zhè gè huó dòng huì chǎng yǒu fú wù zhōng xīn ， xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà ， kě yǐ qǐng fú wù rén yuán guǎng bō 。
en: Because of the power outage, if you want to hear about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast  , which has a service center, and if you want someone, you can call a waiter.

zh: 這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。
py: zhè jǐ tiān diàn shì shàng yī lián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎo yǎn pāi de diàn yǐng ， yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎo kàn 。
en: The last few days saw several films by the same director, one better than one.

zh: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
py: zhè cì de shuǐ zāi bù jǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē ， hǎo jǐ jiā gōng chǎng yě yīn wèi yān shuǐ méi bàn fǎ shēng chǎn ， zhēn shì tài zāo le ！
en: It's too bad that not only did the flood flood the entire street, but several factories couldn't produce because of the flooding.

zh: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng tū rán fā shēng qiáng liè dì zhèn ， xué xiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le ， hái hǎo méi rén shòu shāng 。
en: Last night there was a violent earthquake, and the bridge next to the school collapsed and no one was hurt.

zh: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
py: cóng zhè lǐ zǒu lù huí jiā yǒu yī diǎn ér jù lí ， ér qiě xiàn zài hái xià zhù dà yǔ ， wǒ men hái shì dā jì chéng chē suàn le 。
en: There's a little distance to walk home from here, and it's still raining, so let's take a cab.

zh: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
py: xiàn zài de kē jì hěn jìn bù ， wàn yī mí le lù ， jiù kě yǐ lì yòng wǎng lù dì tú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù 。
en: The technology is progressing, and if you get lost, you can use the Internet map to find a way home.

zh: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
py: yīn wèi yǒu rén hē jiǔ hòu kāi chē ， zào chéng le yán zhòng de jiāo tōng yì wài ， jǐng chá hé jiù hù chē dōu gǎn lái le   bù guǎn chū guó gōng zuò huò liú xué ， yí dìng dé mǎi gè píng ān bǎo xiǎn ， wàn yī fā shēng shén me yì wài cái néng dé dào bāng zhù 。
en: As a result of the serious traffic accident caused by drinking and driving, the police and ambulance came to `br', regardless of whether they were working abroad or studying abroad, they had to buy a safe insurance policy in case of an accident.

zh: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
py: zhè gè xīng qī jīng lǐ yī lián xiě le sān gè tuī xiāo xīn chǎn pǐn de jì huà ， měi tiān dōu máng dé bù dé le 。
en: This week, the manager wrote three plans for the marketing of new products, and he was busy every day.

zh: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
py: jīn tiān shì wǒ nǚ ér shí suì de shēng rì ， wǒ zài dàn gāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn là zhú ， yī gēn dài biǎo yī suì 。
en: It's my daughter's 10th birthday, and I put 10 candles on the cake, one for a year.

zh: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
py: chén lǎo shī wèi le yǐn qǐ xué shēng de xué xí xìng qù ， měi cì shàng kè qián dōu huì zhǔn bèi yī xiē yǒu qù de yóu xì 。
en: Mr. Chen prepares interesting games before attending school in order to interest students in their studies.

zh: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
py: zài shān shàng kǎo ròu shí yào fēi cháng zhù yì ， yí bù xiǎo xīn jiù kě néng yǐn qǐ sēn lín huǒ zāi 。
en: When roasting on a mountain, great care must be taken to cause a forest fire if care is taken.

zh: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
py: wèi le tí gāo yīng wén chéng dù ， wǒ chú le rèn zhēn shàng kè 、 xiě zuò yè ， hái měi tiān tīng shōu yīn jī de yīng wén guǎng bō 。
en: In order to improve English, I listen to the English radio every day, in addition to attending classes and writing.

zh: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
py: wǒ hé zǐ zǐ xiǎo shí hòu cháng wèi le qiǎng wán jù chǎo gè méi wán ， yǒu shí hòu hái dǎ jià ne   nà chǎng yǎn chàng huì qǐng dào le dà jiā zuì xǐ ài de míng xīng ， suǒ yǐ mén piào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le 。
en: When I was a kid, my sister and I used to fight over toys, and sometimes we got our favorite star at the `br' concert, so the tickets were taken away.

zh: 昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng de fēng yǔ shēng hǎo kě pà ， ràng wǒ zhěng gè wǎn shàng dōu méi shuì hǎo 。
en: Last night's storm was so terrible that I didn't sleep well all night.

zh: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
py: A: zhè gè wán jù suī rán kě ài ， dàn shì bù shì hé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de hái zi ， wǒ men hái shì sòng hóng bāo ba ！ B: yě hǎo 。 sòng hóng bāo yě bù cuò 。
en: A: This toy is cute, but it's not for the full moon, so let's get a red bag. B: Yeah. It's good.

zh: 臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。
py: tái wān shì yī gè hǎi dǎo guó jiā ， zhōu wéi de hǎi dǐ yǒu fēng fù de zhēn guì zī yuán 。
en: Taiwan is an island nation, surrounded by abundant and valuable resources.

zh: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ jiān bǎng téng de yuán yīn ， shì yīn wèi zhǎng shí jiān dǎ diàn nǎo de guān xì 。
en: The doctor said you had a pain in your shoulder because you had a long computer connection.

zh: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
py: nà jiā biàn lì shāng diàn de dì lǐ wèi zhì fēi cháng hǎo ， tíng chē yě hěn fāng biàn ， nán guài shēng yì nà me hǎo 。
en: The convenience store was very well located and parking was convenient, so no wonder the business was so good.

zh: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
py: zhè gè dì qū shì gè wēi xiǎn dì dài ， yīn wèi jīng cháng yī xià yǔ jiù yǒu shí tóu diào xià lái ， yǒu shí hòu lián lù dōu huì tā le 。
en: This area is a dangerous area, because often stones fall in the rain and sometimes even roads collapse.

zh: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
py: shì jiè yùn dòng huì de guī mó hěn dà ， měi huí jǔ bàn shí ， wǔ dà zhōu de guó jiā dōu huì lái cān jiā 。
en: The World Games are very large, and every time they come back, countries from five continents come.

zh: 弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。
py: dì di gǎn mào le ， kě shì tā bù dàn bù chī yào ， hái yī lián chī le sān wǎn bīng ， jié guǒ ké sòu ké dé yuè lái yuè yán zhòng le 。
en: His brother had a cold, but instead of taking his medication, he ate three bowls of ice and coughed more and more.

zh: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
py: zhè cì qiáng liè dì zhèn zào chéng le yán zhòng de zāi qíng ， bù dàn xǔ duō fáng wū tā le ， lián qiáo yě duàn le 。
en: The severe earthquake caused a serious disaster, not only with the collapse of many houses but also with the breakdown of bridges.

zh: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
py: xià tiān de yè wǎn ， rén men xǐ huān zài wū zi wài miàn chuī zhù fēng 、 hē zhù chá ， liáo liáo yǒu qù de shì 。
en: During summer nights, people like to blow the wind outside the house, drink tea and talk about interesting things.

zh: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
py: dōng bù shān qū yī lián xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dà yǔ ， yǒu xiē fáng zi dào le ， gōng lù yě tā le ， zào chéng bù shǎo yì wài 。
en: After several days of heavy rains in the eastern mountains, some houses collapsed and roads collapsed, causing a number of accidents.

zh: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
py: zhè gè dì qū yīn wèi dào chù yān shuǐ ， zǒu lù 、 kāi chē dōu hěn kùn nán ， lián wǎng lù yě bù tōng le 。
en: The area is difficult to walk and drive because of flooding everywhere, and the Internet is out of reach.

zh: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
py: yīn wèi shuǐ zāi de guān xì ， xǔ duō xué xiào méi bàn fǎ zhèng cháng shàng kè ， shèn zhì lián biàn lì shāng diàn dōu guān le 。
en: Because of the floods, many schools are unable to attend school properly and even convenience stores are closed.

zh: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
py: qián miàn fā shēng le jiāo tōng yì wài ， wèi le bì miǎn bèi kùn zài lù shàng ， wǒ men hái shì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba 。
en: There's been a traffic accident ahead, and in order to avoid being trapped on the road, let's go another way.

zh: 因為天氣太熱了，有一隻貓在車子底下休息，不肯離開。
py: yīn wèi tiān qì tài rè le ， yǒu yī zhī māo zài chē zi dǐ xià xiū xī ， bù kěn lí kāi 。
en: Because the weather was too hot, a cat rested under the car and refused to leave.

zh: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
py: wǒ zuó tiān qīn yǎn kàn dào xiǎo shǐ gēn rén chǎo jià ， cái zhī dào tā mà rén de yàng zi hǎo kě pà ō ！
en: I saw Shizuku fight yesterday before I knew how horrible he was.

zh: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
py: tái wān rén zài guó wài pèng dào wèn tí shí ， kě yǐ lì kè dǎ 0800-085-095「 nǐ bāng wǒ ， nǐ jiù wǒ 」 zhè zhī diàn huà qiú jiù 。
en: The Taiwanese can immediately call 0800-085-095 "You help me, help me" when they have problems abroad.

zh: A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
py: A: yī shēng ， wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiù jiù wǒ de māo 。 B: bié jí ！ wǒ mǎ shàng jiǎn chá 。
en: A: Doctor, I beg you, save my cat. B: Take it easy. I'll check it out.

zh: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
py: nà chǎng qiáng liè dì zhèn fā shēng yǐ hòu ， xǔ duō guó jiā de zhuān yè rén yuán dōu lái jiù zāi ， ràng rén fēi cháng gǎn dòng 。
en: After the powerful earthquake, it was very touching that professionals from many countries came to rescue the disaster.

zh: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
py: dāng jūn duì yī dào dá zāi qū ， jiù tīng dào le qiú jiù de shēng yīn ， suǒ yǐ lì kè kāi shǐ jiù zāi gōng zuò 。
en: As soon as the army arrived in the area, it heard a call for help, so it began to do so.

zh: 救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。
py: jiù zāi gōng zuò bù róng yì ， yī gè rén de lì liàng shì bù gòu de ， dé dà jiā yì qǐ lái 。
en: It is not easy to rescue. One is not strong enough. We must all come together.

zh: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
py: zhè cì de diàn nǎo zhǎn jí hé le gè guó yǒu míng de pái zi ， hěn zhí de cān guān   lǎo shī yào dài wǒ men qù cān guān bó wù guǎn ， míng tiān zǎo shàng jiǔ diǎn zài xiào mén kǒu jí hé 。
en: This computer show, which brings together famous brands from all over the country, is worth a visit to the museum by teacher `br', to meet at the school gate tomorrow morning at 9:00 a.m.

zh: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
py: yǒu yī xiē bìng rén bù kěn guāi guāi chī yào ， hù lǐ shī dé yǒu nài xīn ， màn màn dì gēn tā men jiǎng dào lǐ 。
en: Some patients refuse to take their medications and nurses have to be patient and slowly reasoned with them.

zh: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
py: yī tīng shuō tái fēng kuài lái le ， xǔ duō mín zhòng jiù qù chāo shì qiǎng gòu shū cài 、 shuǐ guǒ 、 pào miàn děng shí wù 。
en: As soon as they heard that the hurricane was coming, many people went to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruits, noodles, etc.

zh: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
py: jūn rén yòng kǎ chē bǎ shí wù hé shēng huó yòng pǐn sòng dào zāi qū ， fā gěi xū yào de mín zhòng 。
en: The army used trucks to send food and food supplies to the disaster areas and to deliver them to those in need.

zh: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
py: zhǐ yǒu jí hé dà jiā de lì liàng ， yǒu qián chū qián 、 yǒu lì chū lì ， cái néng bāng zhù zāi mín zǎo yī diǎn huī fù zhèng cháng shēng huó 。
en: It is only by bringing together all of us, with money and strength that we can help the victims to return to normal life sooner rather than later.

zh: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
py: jiǔ èr yī dà dì zhèn shí ， tái wān rén fā huī le hù xiāng bāng zhù de jīng shén ， ràng rén fēi cháng gǎn dòng 。
en: During the 921 earthquake, the Taiwanese were very moving in their spirit of mutual help.

zh: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
py: cóng míng tiān qǐ tiān qì huì biàn lěng ， wēn dù huì bǐ jīn tiān jiàng dī wǔ dù ， chū mén shí zuì hǎo chuān shàng wài tào 。
en: The weather will be cold from tomorrow, the temperature will be five degrees lower than today, and it's best to wear a coat when you leave.

zh: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
py: nà gè xiǎo hái zài zhè chǎng dà dì zhèn zhōng shī qù le qīn rén ， shí zài tài kě lián le 。
en: It's too bad the kid lost his family in this big earthquake.

zh: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
py: yī shēng de gōng zuò shì ràng bìng rén huī fù jiàn kāng ， shèn zhì bǎ bǎo guì de shēng mìng jiù huí lái ， suǒ yǐ wǒ men yīng gāi zūn jìng yī shēng 。
en: The doctor's job is to restore the patient's health and even save precious lives, so we should respect the doctor.

zh: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
py: méi yǒu rén zhī dào zì jǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō zhǎng ，  suǒ yǐ měi tiān dōu yīng gāi hǎo hǎo guò rì zi   bù shǎo rén xiāng xìn rén de mìng shì bèi jué dìng de ，  shuí dōu gǎi biàn bù liǎo 。
en: No one knows how long they can live, so many people believe that life is decided, and no one can change.

zh: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de xiū xián huó dòng shì pá shān hé lù yíng   wèi le shēn tǐ hé xīn lǐ de jiàn kāng ， jiù suàn zài máng ， jià rì yě yīng gāi xiū xián yī xià 。
en: My favorite leisure activities are climbing and camping for physical and psychological health.

zh: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
py: rú guǒ zhè gè zhōu mò nǐ méi yǒu shén me dǎ suàn ， yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kàn kàn tái wān guī mó zuì dà de shū diàn ？
en: If you don't have any plans this weekend, why don't you come with me to the biggest bookshop in Taiwan?

zh: 我本來打算下星期騎車環島，但是颱風剛過，想來想去，還是決定不去了。
py: wǒ běn lái dǎ suàn xià xīng qī qí chē huán dǎo ， dàn shì tái fēng gāng guò ， xiǎng lái xiǎng qù ， hái shì jué dìng bù qù le 。
en: I was going to ride around the island next week, but the hurricane just passed and decided not to.

zh: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
py: A:  xiàn zài de kē jì tí gōng fēi cháng hǎo yòng de wǎng lù fú wù ， ér qiě hěn duō dōu shì miǎn fèi de 。 B:  hǎo yòng dǎo shì hǎo yòng ， kě shì wàn yī méi yǒu wǎng lù ， jiù shén me dōu zuò bù liǎo le 。
en: A: Technology now provides very good Internet services, and many of them are free. B: Good use is good use, but in the absence of the Internet, nothing can be done.

zh: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
py: dà bǎo míng nián yǒu qù yīng guó liú xué de dǎ suàn ， suǒ yǐ zhǎo le jiā tíng jiào shī bāng tā bǔ xí ，  xī wàng tí gāo yīng wén chéng dù 。
en: Dabao's going to study in England next year, so he's got a tutor to help him with his studies, hoping to improve his English skills.

zh: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
py: zhè cì shè qū de zhōng qiū jié huó dòng ， jué dìng zài hù wài jǔ bàn ， wàn yī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shì nèi qù 。
en: The community's Mid-Autumn event decided to hold it outside and move inside in case of rain.

zh: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
py: wáng lǎo bǎn jǔ bàn le yī gè miǎn fèi chī sōng bǐng de huó dòng ， mù dì shì diào chá nǎ zhǒng kǒu wèi de sōng bǐng zuì shòu huān yíng 。
en: Mr. Wang organized a free muffin event to investigate the most popular kind of muffins.

zh: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
py: zhè gè chéng shì yī lián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ ， zào chéng hěn duō dì qū yān shuǐ ， sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le 。
en: After five days of rain in the city, many areas were flooded and one third of the roads were out of reach.

en: In order to improve the quality of life of children and adolescents, the market has increased the number of leisure places such as playgrounds and swimming pools.

en: Just a few days after the earthquake, the people of the disaster zone received $50 million in clothing and food, as well as surprises.

en: Every winter comes, uncles and aunts plan to go skiing and sometimes ask me to go with their mother.

en: Skiing is a very exciting activity and requires good skills, Ms.   Lee, who can't stand the stimuli of divorce and who hasn't been able to eat and sleep well for days.

en: The company pays great attention to the physical and mental health of its employees and arranges a five-day trip to the island every year, which can also be attended by family members.

zh: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
py: wǒ bù tài xǐ huān liú hěn duō hàn ， suǒ yǐ bù cháng pǎo bù ， bǐ jiào xǐ huān zài gōng yuán sàn bù 。
en: I don't like to sweat much, so I don't run much, I prefer to walk in the park.

zh: 台灣的周圍都是海，還有不少美麗的海灘。

en: Taiwan is surrounded by the sea, and there are beautiful beaches.

en: That shop is selling chocolate-flavored buns. Shall we try it?

zh: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
py: ōu xiān shēng yǒu yuè dú de zhàng ài ， jiù suàn yī piān jí duǎn de wén zhāng ， dú qǐ lái yě jué dé hěn kùn nán 。
en: Mr. O ' , who is handicapped from reading, finds it difficult to read even a very short article.

zh: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
py: xiǎo hán yì zhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòu fǔ de wèi dào ， zuó tiān zhōng yú kè fú le xīn lǐ zhàng ài ， bǎ chòu dòu fǔ chī xià qù le 。
en: Han couldn't stand the smell of stinking tofu. Yesterday, he finally overcome the psychological barrier and ate the tofu.

zh: 夏天一到，這個海灘上就會看到許多人帶著衝浪板來衝浪。
py: xià tiān yī dào ， zhè gè hǎi tān shàng jiù huì kàn dào xǔ duō rén dài zhù chōng làng bǎn lái chōng làng 。
en: As soon as summer arrives, there will be a lot of people on this beach surfing with boardboards.

zh: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
py: xiǎo zhōu cái sān shí suì ， jiù qù guò sì shí jǐ gè guó jiā ， shèn zhì qù guò yī xiē yòu wēi xiǎn yòu cì jī de dì fāng ， zhēn shì tài kù le ！
en: It's so cool when you're 30 years old, you've been to over 40 countries, and you've even been to some dangerous and exciting places.

zh: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
py: tài tài ： wǒ jīn tiān hěn lèi ， bù xiǎng zuò fàn 。  xiān shēng ： nà jiù jiào pī sà hǎo le 。 yòu kuài yòu bù má fán 。
en: Ma'am: I'm tired today and I don't want to cook.

py: nà gè gōng rén shǐ yòng gōng chǎng de jī qì shí ， bù xiǎo xīn fā shēng le yì wài ， liú le hěn duō xuè 。
en: When the worker used the machine of the factory, an accident occurred and a lot of blood was shed.

zh: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。

en: He's seen a doctor a few times, he's taken his medicine for weeks, and he's finally cured.

zh: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
py: jì rán nǐ bù xiǎng chōng làng ， nà jiù zuò zài hǎi tān shàng shài shài tài yáng ba ！
en: If you don't want to surf, then sit on the beach and turn on the sun!

zh: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
py: jì rán nǐ nà me xǐ huān zhāng xiǎo jiě ， jiù yīng gāi zhǔ dòng yī diǎn ， yuē tā qù kàn diàn yǐng 、 chī gè fàn shén me de 。
en: If you like Miss Cheung so much, you should start asking her to go to the movies, eat something.

zh: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。

en: If you eat in this restaurant for $2,000, the boss will treat a plate of fried vegetables free of charge.

zh: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
py: zhēn zhēn měi tiān dà yuē kàn liǎng gè xiǎo shí de tái wān lián xù jù ， mù dì shì yào ( xùn ) liàn zì jǐ de zhōng wén tīng lì   dà xióng cháng lì yòng zhōu mò liàn ( xí ) shū fǎ ， suǒ yǐ hàn zì xiě dé bǐ qí tā tóng xué dōu hǎo kàn 。
en: Precious has been watching the Taiwan series for about two hours a day in order to (train) his own Chinese-language hearing  , often using weekend law, so the Chinese writing is better than the rest of the students.

zh: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
py: nà jiā dòng wù cān tīng de kōng jiān hěn dà ， kě yǐ ràng kè rén de xiǎo dòng wù zì yóu zì zài dì huó dòng 。
en: There's plenty of room in that animal restaurant to let the animals of the guests move freely.

zh: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。

en: The company's production department planned a staff tour this month, and there were three different places for people to choose.

zh: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。

en: Many young people had to sacrifice their holidays to study in order to get a good school.

zh: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
py: xiǎo wēn guī huà de lǚ yóu xíng chéng ， yǒu cān guān 、 gòu wù 、 kàn biǎo yǎn děng huó dòng ， wǒ xiāng xìn dà jiā huì hěn mǎn yì 。
en: I'm sure you'll be happy to have a tour planned by Wen, with a tour, shopping, a performance, and so on.

zh: 我們的足球教練認為，比賽前跑步是必要的訓練，從明天起每天得跑一個小時。
py: wǒ men de zú qiú jiào liàn rèn wèi ， bǐ sài qián pǎo bù shì bì yào de xùn liàn ， cóng míng tiān qǐ měi tiān dé pǎo yī gè xiǎo shí 。
en: Our football coach believes that running before the game is a necessary training, one hour a day from tomorrow.

en: My house was by the road, and the noise from morning to evening seriously affected the quality of life and decided to move.

en: Mom's working late today. I have to take care of my sister. I can't go home early.

en: White drank too much and was already drunk to keep him drinking.

en: When I was trying to call Young-young, I didn't think she'd call first.

en: The work of the police is primarily to protect the population from harm to good people.

zh: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
py: xiàn zài tū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ ， wǒ men de jì huà bèi pò huài le ， kǒng pà jīn tiān suǒ yǒu de huó dòng dōu bì xū chóng xīn ān pái 。
en: Now it's raining heavily, and our plans are ruined, and I'm afraid all the events today have to be rescheduled.

en: Grandpa loves fishing by the sea, watching the view, blowing the wind, and he feels so comfortable.

py: lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā ， wǒ cháng cháng zhāi yī xiē fàng zài shū zhuō shàng ， kàn zhù kàn zhù xīn qíng jiù yú kuài le   jìn bàn gōng shì qián ， bié wàng le zhāi xià mào zi ， zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐ mào 。
en: There's a lot of white flowers on the side of the road, and it's a courtesy to take some of them off the desk and look at the mood before br gets into the office.

en: After his participation in the service group, he lived a richer and more meaningful life than in the past.

en: After the earthquake, the rescuers took a second and tried to rescue the people trapped under the house.

zh: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。

en: The backpackers often take someone else's car to the next location in order to understand the cost of transportation.

zh: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。

en: Compared to group travel, I think a man is much more free to travel and can train himself to solve his problems.

en: I've had a full weekend, not only with my final report, but also with my classmates, swimming and surfing.

en: Stinky tofu is a famous Taiwan snack, but the taste is unique and not acceptable to everyone.

zh: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。

en: In the wake of the major earthquake, the people showed their love and offered relief supplies to the victims.

zh: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。

en: The tablet's instructions are very detailed, so the guests can see for themselves.

zh: 小張對世界地理和歷史相當有興趣，為了打開視野，他決定花一年的時間出國旅行。
py: xiǎo zhāng duì shì jiè dì lǐ hé lì shǐ xiāng dāng yǒu xìng qù ， wèi le dǎ kāi shì yě ， tā jué dìng huā yī nián de shí jiān chū guó lǚ xíng 。
en: Zhang was very interested in world geography and history, and in order to open his eyes, he decided to spend a year travelling abroad.

en: I think the most memorable memory should be "first time" experience, like the first time in love, the first time as a backpacker, and so on.

en: The sky suddenly rained and my clothes and hair were wet.

en: The city has changed considerably, and a number of old houses have become new buildings.

en: The weather reporter is sure that the hurricane will be here tomorrow, and we'd better go to the supermarket and buy some noodles, eggs <br's boss wants me to travel south on a fixed date, and if anything changes, he'll let me know sooner.

zh: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。

en: Taiwan passports are much better used than before, and travel to many countries does not require a visa.

en: The weather report says that for three days from tomorrow, the temperature in the north of the centre is only 15 degrees, and it is best to have a coat on the way out.

zh: 這個地區的地形有三分之一是平原，三分之二是高山。

en: One third of the terrain in this area is in plains and two thirds in mountains.

zh: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
