py: nǐ zài míng pái fú zhuāng de zhuān guì gōng zuò ， wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuān zhù hé pǐn wèi de kàn fǎ 。
en: You work in the locker of a brand-new dress, and I'd like to hear your opinion of dress and taste.

zh: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
py: wǒ gēn dì di shì shuāng bāo tāi ， hěn duō rén dōu yǐ wèi wǒ shì tā ， zhè yàng de wù huì wǒ zǎo jiù xí guàn le  A: hé xiǎo jiě zhǐ shì wǒ de lín jū ， bú shì wǒ de nǚ péng yǒu ， dà jiā dōu wù huì le 。 B: nǐ duì tā hěn tǐ tiē ， bù dàn cháng sòng tā shàng bān ， hái cháng péi tā guàng jiē ， dà jiā duì nǐ men yǒu wù huì yě shì zhèng cháng de 。
en: My brother and I are twins, and many people think that I am him. I've been used to this misunderstanding. Miss Ho is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend, and everyone is mistaken. B: You are very kind to her, not only sending her to work, but also walking with her, and it is normal for you to have a misunderstanding.

zh: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
py: zài suǒ yǒu de tóng shì zhōng ， wǒ jué dé xiǎo zhōu zuì hǎo xiāng chù le 。 tā de xìng gé kāi lǎng 、 shuō huà yōu mò ， hái cháng zhǔ dòng bāng máng ， gēn tā xiāng chù qǐ lái hěn yú kuài 、 hěn zì zài 。
en: Of all my colleagues, I think it's best for Cho to get along with each other. He's got a good personality, a funny voice, and he's always helping out, and he's happy and comfortable with him.

zh: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
py: xiàng chōng làng 、 huá xuě nà yàng de hù wài huó dòng ， yòu cì jī yòu hǎo wán ， bù yòng shuō ， jué duì néng xī yǐn qīng shào nián 。
en: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are exciting and fun.

zh: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
py: néng bù néng qí zì xíng chē wán chéng huán dǎo de xíng chéng ， gēn nài xīn yǒu guān ， gēn cōng míng bù cōng míng wú guān 。
en: It's about patience, it's not about smartness.

zh: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
py: A: tīng shuō míng tiān de huì gēn xīn shāng pǐn de tuī xiāo jì huà yǒu guān ， nǐ yào cān jiā ma ？ B: wǒ shì gōng sī de ān quán rén yuán ， zhè gè huì yīng gāi gēn wǒ wú guān 。
en: B: I'm a security agent for the company, and this should be none of my business.

zh: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
py: yán xiān shēng duì chī 、 hē dōu hěn jiǎng jiū ， chī niú pái shí yīng gāi hē shén me jiǔ ， tā yě hěn yǒu yán jiū 。
en: Mr. Yin is very good at eating and drinking, and he has a lot of research on what to drink when he eats steaks.

zh: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
py: bù guǎn shì shuí ， rú guǒ shī qù le qīn ài de jiā rén ， yí dìng huì hěn shāng xīn 、 hěn tòng kǔ ， zhè shì hěn zì rán de   nà gè nǚ yǎn yuán yǎn xì de yàng zi hěn zì rán ， yī diǎn yě bù kuā zhāng ， nán guài dǎo yǎn hěn xīn shǎng tā 。
en: Whoever lost her dear family would be very sad and painful. It was natural for the actress to act and not exaggerate. No wonder the director admired her.

zh: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
py: duì huá rén lái shuō ， kǒng zi shì dì wèi zuì gāo 、 zuì wěi dà de lǎo shī ， tā de sī xiǎng yǐng xiǎng le hěn duō rén 。
en: For the Chinese, Confucius is the highest and greatest teacher, and his thoughts affect many people.

zh: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
py: yǒu rén shuō ， nán rén de huà tí cháng gēn zhèng zhì yǒu guān ， nǚ rén de huà tí bú shì míng pái bāo 、 jiù shì huà zhuāng pǐn 。 nǐ tóng yì ma ？
en: Some say that men's talk is often about politics. Women's talk is about brand bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

zh: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
py: zhè gè dì qū bù jǐn méi yǒu dì zhèn 、 tái fēng ， ér qiě tiān qì hǎo 、 kōng qì xīn xiān ， shēng huó huán jìng ān quán yòu shū shì 。
en: Not only is there no earthquake, no typhoon, but the weather is good, the air is fresh and the living environment is safe and comfortable.

zh: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
py: lín xiǎo jiě cóng xiǎo jiù xī wàng yǒu yī jiā shǔ yú zì jǐ de miàn bāo diàn ， jīn nián zhōng yú mèng xiǎng chéng zhēn le 。
en: Miss Lin wanted to have a bakery of her own since she was a child, and this year the dream came true.

zh: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
py: zhè dòng shāng yè dà lóu de guī mó hěn dà ， chú le yǒu hěn duō shāng diàn 、 cān tīng ， hái yǒu diàn yǐng yuàn 、 jiàn shēn fáng 。
en: The size of the commercial building is large, with many shops, restaurants, cinemas, gyms, etc.

zh: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
py: yǒu rén shuō fā shēng dà dì zhèn yǐ qián ， xiǎo dòng wù huì luàn pǎo 、 luàn jiào ， zhè shì hěn zì rán de xiàn xiàng 。
en: It's natural to say that before the earthquake, little animals would run and scream.

zh: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
py: wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu ， nǐ wǎng xī zǒu ， wǒ men liǎng gè de fāng xiàng gāng hǎo xiāng fǎn 。
en: I'm going east, you're going west, we're going the opposite way.

zh: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
py: qù nián shēng rì bà bà sòng le wǒ yī liàng zì xíng chē ， cóng nà tiān qǐ ， wǒ jiù tiān tiān qí zhù tā qù shàng xué 。
en: Last year's birthday dad gave me a bike, and since that day I've been riding it to school every day.

zh: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
py: yīn wèi gōng zuò tài máng de guān xì ， xià xiǎo jiě yǐ jīng yǒu yī duàn shí jiān méi shàng jiē gòu wù le 。
en: Miss Hsia hasn't been shopping for a while because of her busy work.

zh: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
py: zhù zài xué xiào sù shè yǒu yī xiē xiàn zhì ， bǐ rú shuō wǎn shàng shí diǎn qián bì xū huí dào sù shè 。
en: There are limitations to living in a school dormitory, such as having to return to the dormitory by 10:00 p.m.

zh: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
py: zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu huì bāng zhù nǐ 、 guān xīn nǐ ， shì jué duì bù huì shāng hài nǐ de   qīng shào nián cháng yīn wèi bù liǎo jiě ér wù huì fù mǔ de jiào yù fāng shì ， huò xǔ děng tā men zhǎng dà le ， jiù néng zhēn zhèng míng bái le 。
en: True friends will help you, care for you, and they will never hurt your `br' teenagers, who often misunderstand their parents' ways of education because they don't understand, or maybe when they grow up, they will really understand.

zh: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
py: fù mǔ yào jīng cháng péi hái zi liáo tiān 、 wán yóu xì ， gěi líng yòng qián bù néng wán quán mǎn zú hái zi de xū yào 。
en: Parents often talk with their children, play games and give money for money that does not fully meet the needs of their children.

zh: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
py: xiǎo hé chuān zhù lǜ sè niú zǎi kù 、 hóng chèn shān ， zài dài shàng lán sè de mào zi ， wǒ jué dé zhè xiē yán sè pèi zài yì qǐ hěn chǒu 。
en: Little Ho wears green jeans, red shirts and blue hats, and I think these colors are ugly.

zh: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
py: xiǎo dài dì yī cì gēn nǚ péng yǒu de fù mǔ jiàn miàn shí ， jǐn zhāng dé bù dé le ， shuō huà 、 chī fàn dōu hěn bù zì zài 。
en: During his first meeting with his girlfriend's parents, Tai was nervous and was uncomfortable talking and eating.

zh: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
py: nà wèi lǎo tài tài nián jì dà le ， méi bàn fǎ zhào gù tā de gǒu ， suǒ yǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo gè xīn zhǔ rén 。
en: The old lady was too old to take care of his dog, so she wanted to find a new owner for the dog.

zh: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
py: zhāng xiān shēng huá xuě de jì qiǎo hěn hǎo ， zhè cì bǐ sài tā yǒu xìn xīn néng gòu dé dào qián sān míng 。
en: Mr. Cheung is very good at skiing, and he's confident he'll get the top three in this race.

zh: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
py: cān jiā lán qiú shè de tiáo jiàn shì pǎo bù de sù dù dé gòu kuài ， dàn shì méi yǒu shēn gāo de xiàn zhì 。
en: Participation in basketball clubs is conditional on running fast enough, but with no limit on height.

zh: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
py: bù shǎo wài guó rén shuō ， tái wān zuì dà de mèi lì shì rén men néng gòu jiē shòu bù tóng de wén huà 、 yǔ yán hé xiǎng fǎ ， suǒ yǐ zài tái wān shēng huó fēi cháng zì zài 。
en: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages and ideas, so they are very comfortable living in Taiwan.

zh: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
py: yì bān lái shuō ， xiǎo gǎn mào zhǐ yào duō hē shuǐ 、 duō xiū xī jiù xíng le ， bù xū yào kàn bìng 、 chī yào 。
en: Generally speaking, a flu requires more water and rest and does not require medical attention or medication.

zh: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
py: wǒ men gōng sī dǎ suàn jīn nián gēn měi guó hé zuò ， shēng chǎn míng pái pí bāo   chú xī nà tiān ， dà jiā dōu máng zhù dǎ sǎo 、 tiē chūn lián ， zhǐ yǒu dì di hěn bù hé zuò ， shén me shì dōu bù zuò 。
en: Our company is planning to work with the United States this year to produce a brand-new bag on New Year's Eve.

zh: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
py: zhè gè jì niàn táng shì wèi le jì niàn nà xiē wèi guó jiā xī shēng shēng mìng de jūn rén 。
en: This memorial is a tribute to those soldiers who have sacrificed their lives for the country.

zh: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
py: diàn shì shàng zhèng zài bō chū kuà nián yǎn chàng huì ， jié mù fēi cháng xī yǐn rén ， nǐ kuài lái kàn ba 。
en: There's an inter-annual concert on TV. The show is very attractive. Come and see it.

zh: 我今天跟同學穿了樣式不同，但是顏色相同的洋裝。
py: wǒ jīn tiān gēn tóng xué chuān le yàng shì bù tóng ， dàn shì yán sè xiàng tóng de yáng zhuāng 。
en: I'm wearing a different dress today than my classmates, but it's the same color.

zh: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
py: duì yé yé lái shuō ， suǒ wèi de 「 hǎo hái zi 」， jiù shì hěn xiào shùn 、 yǒu lǐ mào 、 gōng kè hǎo de hái zi 。
en: For Grandpa, the so-called "good boy" is a child who is kind, polite and well-educated.

zh: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
py: zhè cì dì zhèn de guī mó hěn dà ， lián zǒng tǒng yī shí yě hěn nán zhǎng wò gè dì de zāi qíng 。
en: The magnitude of the earthquake made it difficult for even the President to grasp the situation.

zh: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
py: zhè cì de lù yíng huó dòng yīn wèi tái fēng bàn bù chéng le ， kě yǐ shuō jì huà yǒng yuǎn méi bàn fǎ gǎn shàng biàn huà   zhāng lǎo bǎn kāi huì kāi dé tài jiǔ ， méi gǎn shàng fēi jī ， zhǐ hǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jī piào le 。
en: The camping event, because of the hurricane's inability to do it, can be said that the plan will never make it possible to change the course of the meeting of Mr. `br' Zhang for too long, to get on the plane and to buy another ticket.

zh: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
py: ā lǐ shān yōng yǒu fēng fù de sēn lín zī yuán hé dú tè de zì rán fēng jǐng ， měi nián dōu xī yǐn bù shǎo yóu kè qù nà lǐ lǚ xíng 。
en: Mount Ali, with its rich forest resources and unique natural landscapes, attracts tourists to travel there every year.

zh: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài bù jǐn píng jià ， hái hěn yíng yǎng ， cháng cháng zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn qián jǔ kè mǎn le 。
en: The restaurant, which is not only affordable but also nutritious, is often filled by 12 p.m.

zh: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
py: bái xiǎo jiě píng shí duì chuān zhù bù zěn me jiǎng jiū ， yī fú chuān lái chuān qù zǒng shì nà jǐ jiàn 。
en: Miss White usually doesn't know much about clothes. It's always those clothes.

zh: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
py: wǒ chéng rèn nǐ de zhào xiàng jī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de ， wǒ yí dìng fù zé bǎ tā xiū lǐ hǎo 。
en: I admit I broke your camera. I'm sure I'll fix it.

zh: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
py: xiǎo bì běn lái rèn wèi zì jǐ de shū fǎ xiě dé hěn hǎo ， dàn shì shàng cì bǐ sài shū le yǐ hòu ， tā jiù shī qù zì xìn le 。
en: Xiaobing thought his book writing was good, but he lost his confidence after the last game.

zh: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
py: nà dòng dà lóu fā shēng huǒ zāi shí ， hái hǎo ān quán rén yuán hěn lěng jìng ， cái néng dài zhù dà jiā ān quán dì lí kāi 。
en: When there was a fire in that building, it was good that the security personnel were calm enough to take everyone safely away.

zh: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
py: xiǎo chén rèn wèi tóu tòng shì xiǎo shì ， kuàng qiě zuì jìn máng dé lián xiū xī de shí jiān dōu bù gòu ， suǒ yǐ bù kěn qù kàn bìng 。
en: Chen considers headaches to be a minor matter and has been busy lately without enough time to rest, and has refused to go to the hospital.

zh: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
py: wǒ rèn wèi duō kàn shí shàng zá zhì 、 duō kàn mó tè ér zěn me chuān yī fú ， yīng gāi jiù néng shǐ zì jǐ de chuān zhù gèng yǒu pǐn wèi 。
en: I think a lot of fashion magazines and models should be able to dress themselves better.

zh: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
py: lǎo bǎn shōu dào yī fēng xiě mǎn yuè nán wén de xìn ， bàn gōng shì méi rén kàn de dǒng ， fēi zhǎo rén fān yì bù kě 。
en: The boss received a letter in Vietnamese, and no one in the office understood it.

zh: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
py: tā bì jìng shì gè xiǎo hái zi ， hái bù dǒng zuò rén zuò shì de dào lǐ ， děng tā zhǎng dà jiù huì míng bái le 。
en: After all, he's a little kid who doesn't know how to be human, and he'll understand when he grows up.

zh: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
py: xiǎo zhāng bù jǐn zhǎng dé shuài ， chuān zhù yě hěn yǒu pǐn wèi ， suǒ yǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐ wèi tā shì míng xīng 。
en: Zhang is not only handsome, but well-dressed, so a lot of people think he's a star.

zh: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
py: lǎo shī rèn wèi zhè gè wèn tí hěn nán ， zhǐ yǒu yī gè xué shēng huí dá dé hěn zhèng què ， suǒ yǐ gěi tā jiā le yī xiē fēn shù 。
en: The teacher found the question difficult and only one student answered it correctly, so he was given some points.

zh: 小李第一次參加釣魚比賽就得了第一名，真是幸運。
py: xiǎo lǐ dì yī cì cān jiā diào yú bǐ sài jiù dé le dì yì míng ， zhēn shì xìng yùn 。
en: It's lucky that Li won first place in the first fishing competition.

zh: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
py: zhè jiā chāo shì mài de shāng pǐn dōu shì ān quán de ， ràng gù kè mǎi dé ān xīn 、 chī dé ān xīn ， yòng de yě ān xīn 。
en: This supermarket sells goods that are safe for customers to buy, eat and use.

zh: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
py: dì di zuò le yī gè kě pà de mèng ， yè lǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le   tái wān de xià tiān rè jí le ， yào shì fáng jiān méi yǒu lěng qì ， bàn yè kě néng huì bèi rè xǐng ， shèn zhì zhěng gè wǎn shàng shuì bù zhù 。
en: My brother had a terrible dream, he woke up at 3:00 a.m. in the summer in Taiwan, and if there was no air in the room, he might wake up in the middle of the night, and he couldn't sleep all night.

zh: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
py: A:「 kuài shí shàng 」 de fú zhuāng zhǐ yǒu gāng chū lái de tóu jǐ gè yuè shòu huān yíng 。 B: ó ？ nǐ de yì si shì 「 kuài shí shàng 」 de yī fú hěn kuài jiù shī qù mèi lì le ma ？
en: A: Fast Fashion is only popular in the first few months of its existence. B: Oh, do you mean fast-fashion clothes soon become unattractive?

zh: 今天的數學考試我只考了三十分，要是被爸爸知道，他一定會罵我的。
py: jīn tiān de shù xué kǎo shì wǒ zhǐ kǎo le sān shí fēn ， yào shì bèi bà bà zhī dào ， tā yí dìng huì mà wǒ de 。
en: I only took 30 points of the math test today, and if Dad knew it, he would have scolded me.

zh: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
py: hǎo jǐ gè rén dōu kàn dào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒ zāi yǒu guān ， tā bù dàn bù chéng rèn ， fǎn ér shuō shì lín jū zuò de 。
en: Several people saw him involved in the fire, and instead of admitting it, he said that the neighbours had done it.

zh: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
py: tā zuò shì de tài dù hěn chà ， ér qiě yī bù gāo xìng jiù mà rén ， shuí shòu dé le zhè zhǒng rén a ！
en: He's got a bad attitude and he yells at me when he's not happy. Who can stand such a man?

zh: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
py: fù mǔ chú le jiào dǎo hái zi zuò rén zuò shì de dào lǐ ， yě yīng gāi kěn dìng tā men de biǎo xiàn ， ràng tā men gèng yǒu zì xìn 。
en: In addition to teaching children the logic of being human, parents should recognize their performance and make them more confident.

zh: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
py: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎo jiě tái wān shè huì de rén 、 shì 、 wù ， zuì hǎo qīn zì lái tái wān zhù yī duàn shí jiān 。
en: If you want to know about people, things and things in Taiwan society, you should come and live in Taiwan for a while.

zh: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
py: zhè táng kè de nèi róng gēn wén huà yǒu guān ， suǒ yǐ lǎo shī bǎ jiào xué zhòng xīn fàng zài jiè shào gè guó de wén huà tè sè 。
en: The content of the course is cultural, so teachers focus on the cultural characteristics of each country.

zh: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
py: xiǎo dài cái sān shí suì jiù yǐ jīng shì míng pái fú zhuāng gōng sī de dà lǎo bǎn ， zhè me nián qīng jiù yǒu zhè yàng de chéng jiù ， shí zài bù jiǎn dān 。
en: It's not easy to be young enough to be the boss of a brand-new dress company when he's only 30 years old.

zh: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
py: rú guǒ nǐ néng zhǎng wò lǎo shī jiào xué de zhòng yào nèi róng ， zhè cì de cè yàn jiù yí dìng néng dé dào gāo fēn   wèi le cè yàn chū xué shēng de huá yǔ chéng dù ， xué xiào xī wàng xué shēng cān jiā huá yǔ wén néng lì cè yàn 。
en: If you have access to the important content of your teacher's studies, you will be able to get a high score for this test   in order to test the Chinese language level of the students, who are expected to participate in the Chinese language proficiency test.

zh: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
py: zhè cì qī mò kǎo de tí mù hěn nán ， dà jiā de chéng jī dōu bù hǎo ， hái yǒu jǐ gè rén bèi dāng le 。
en: The finals were difficult, everybody had bad grades, and a few others were taken.

zh: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
py: wǒ tóng xué jì bǐ jì de sù dù hěn kuài ， yě jì dé hěn qīng chǔ ， suǒ yǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐ jì lái fù xí gōng kè 。
en: My classmates took notes very quickly, and I remember them very well, so I used to borrow notes to do my homework with him.

zh: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
py: wǒ de hàn zì kǎo shì zǒng shì bù jí gé ， jīng guò sān gè yuè nǔ lì dì liàn xí ， zhōng yú jí gé le 。
en: After three months of hard work, I failed.

zh: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
py: wáng jiào shòu bù dàn zhī shí hěn fēng fù ， yán jiū chéng guǒ yě shòu dào dà jiā de kěn dìng 。
en: Not only is Professor Wang well-known, but the results of the study have been recognized.

zh: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
py: huáng xiān shēng shàng bān cháng chí dào ， yě bù rèn zhēn gōng zuò ， zhè yàng de tài dù ràng lǎo bǎn hěn bù mǎn 。
en: Mr. Huang is often late for work and he is not serious about his work, which makes the boss very unhappy.

zh: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
py: zhè gè xué qī zhōng wén kè de xīn jiào cái shì shí dài huá yǔ dì sān cè ， yī gòng yǒu shí liù kè 。
en: The new course in Chinese is the third edition of the Chinese language of the semester, which consists of 16 courses.

zh: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
py: yuè lái yuè duō rén shǐ yòng wǎng lù shàng kè ， suǒ yǐ shǒu jī 、 diàn nǎo yě jiù biàn chéng le zhòng yào de xué xí gōng jù 。
en: As more and more people use the Internet, mobile phones and computers become important learning tools.

zh: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
py: zài huá yǔ zhōng xīn ， měi gè xué qī lǎo shī dōu huì dài lǐng xué shēng cān jiā hù wài jiào xué de huó dòng 。
en: At the Chinese Language Centre, every semester teachers lead students to outside education.

zh: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
py: yǒu de rén yī hē niú nǎi jiù lā dù zi ， kě néng shì yīn wèi shēn tǐ xī shōu bù liào niú nǎi de yíng yǎng 。
en: Some suffer from diarrhea when they drink milk, probably because the body absorbs the nourishment of unwanted milk.

zh: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
py: zhè táng yǔ fǎ kè de nèi róng bǐ jiào nán ， xué shēng yǒu rèn hé wèn tí dōu kě yǐ jǔ shǒu qǐng jiào lǎo shī 。
en: The content of this grammar course is difficult, and students can ask teachers for any questions.

zh: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
py: yǒu yī xiē jiā zhǎng duì xiàn zài de shēng xué zhì dù bù mǎn ， rèn wèi xué xiào bù yīng gāi bī hái zi xiě nà me duō cè yàn tí mù 。
en: Some parents are unhappy with the current system of promotion, arguing that schools should not force their children to write so many test questions.

zh: 這個手錶你已經戴了快二十年了吧？他對你有甚麼特殊的意義呢？
py: zhè gè shǒu biǎo nǐ yǐ jīng dài le kuài èr shí nián le ba ？ tā duì nǐ yǒu shén me tè shū de yì yì ne ？
en: You've been wearing this watch for almost 20 years. What does he mean to you?

zh: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
py: zhè gè pái zi de yùn dòng fú zài yè shì mài wǔ bǎi yuán ， kě shì zài bǎi huò gōng sī mài liǎng qiān yuán ， nǐ jué dé hé lǐ ma ？
en: Do you think it makes sense to sell $500 for this brand at the night market, but $2,000 at the department store?

zh: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
py: dāng rén men shēng huó shuǐ zhǔn tí gāo ， kāi shǐ zhòng shì shēng huó pǐn zhì shí ， xiū xián huó dòng yě jiù gēn zhù duō le qǐ lái 。
en: When people live better and start to value their quality of life, leisure activities follow.

zh: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
py: huá yǔ zhōng xīn chú le yǒu péi yǎng xué shēng zhōng wén néng lì de kè chéng ， hái ān pái le wén huà kè ， ràng kè chéng gèng fēng fù 。
en: In addition to the Chinese language training courses available to students, the Chinese Language Centre has arranged cultural classes to enrich them.

zh: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
py: lǎo shī shuō zhè cì kǒu shì de tí mù bù nán ， huí dá shì zhǐ yào fàng qīng sōng 、 bié jǐn zhāng ， jiù méi wèn tí le 。
en: The teacher said the interview was easy, and the answer was to relax and relax, so there would be no problem.

zh: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
py: lǐ xiǎo jiě jié hūn yǐ hòu de shēng huó zhòng xīn jiù shì jiā tíng ， yóu qí shì zhào gù gāng chū shēng de xiǎo hái 。
en: When Miss Lee is married, the focus of her life is on the family, especially on the newly born child.

zh: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
py: zhè cì shù xué kǎo shì de tí mù sì hū nán le diǎn ， yīn wèi chāo guò sān fēn zhī èr de xué shēng kǎo bù jí gé 。
en: The subject of the Mathematical Examination seems to be difficult, as more than two thirds of the students failed.

zh: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
py: zhè gè jiào cái bǐ jiào nán ， lǎo shī pà xué shēng bù róng yì xī shōu ， yīn cǐ lì yòng gè zhǒng jiào xué gōng jù lái bāng zhù xué shēng xué xí 。
en: This material is more difficult, and teachers fear that students will not be easily absorbed and use various teaching tools to help them learn.

zh: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
py: rú guǒ xiǎng de dào jiǎng xué jīn ， bì xū dá chéng měi kē chéng jī bā shí wǔ fēn yǐ shàng de yāo qiú 。
en: If you want to receive a scholarship, you must meet the requirement of more than 85 points per degree.

zh: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
py: míng tiān yào kǎo wǔ kē ， měi kē de cè yàn tí mù gè yǒu wǔ shí tí ， wǒ xiǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng dé kāi yè chē le 。
en: I'm going to take five classes tomorrow, each with 50 questions, and I think we'll have to drive tonight.

zh: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
py: shàng kè shí tā bǎ bǐ jì xiě zài běn zi shàng ， yě bǎ zhòng diǎn xiě zài bù tóng yán sè de biàn tiáo ( zhǐ ) shàng 。
en: During the course, he wrote his notes on the book and also on notes (papers) of different colours.

zh: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
py: zhāng jīng lǐ jīn tiān de gōng zuò xíng chéng ān pái dé hěn mǎn ， lián chī fàn 、 xiū xī de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu 。
en: Manager Zhang's schedule is full today, and he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

zh: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
py: gē gē de xiǎng fǎ hěn bù shí jì ， tā yì zhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō 、 shì shǎo 、 lí jiā jìn de gōng zuò ， dàn zhè zhǒng gōng zuò hěn nán zhǎo a ！
en: My brother's mind is not real. He's always looking for a job that's expensive, easy, close to home, but it's hard to find it.

zh: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
py: wǒ jué dé mǎ xiǎo jiě zhǎo bú dào gōng zuò de yuán yīn bú shì zì jǐ de tiáo jiàn bù gòu hǎo ， shì tā tài quē fá zì xìn le 。
en: I don't think Miss Ma can't find a job because her terms aren't good enough. He's too confident.

zh: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
py: nà suǒ fēi cháng yǒu míng de dà xué měi nián zhǐ lù qǔ yī qiān míng xīn shēng ， chú le dé chéng jī gòu hǎo ， hái xū yào yī diǎn ér yùn qì cái jìn dé qù 。
en: That very well-known university has only a thousand new students a year, and it takes a little bit of luck to get in, in addition to having good grades.

zh: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
py: shì zhǎng jiě jué le bù shǎo zhè gè chéng shì de shēng huó wèn tí ， yīn cǐ mín zhòng de shēng huó shuǐ zhǔn yě dà dà tí gāo le 。
en: The mayor has solved many of the problems of life in the city, and the standard of living of the population has improved considerably.

zh: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
py: wǒ jué dé jiǎn shǎo gōng zuò ， zēng jiā yǒu yì yì de xiū xián huó dòng ， zhè yàng de shēng huó bǐ jiào chōng shí 。
en: I think it's better to have fewer jobs and more meaningful leisure activities.

zh: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
py: dān rèn zhè jiā gōng sī de zhǔ guǎn zhēn bù róng yì ， bù jǐn yào guǎn lǐ zhěng gè bù mén de yuán gōng ， hái yào dá chéng lǎo bǎn de gōng zuò yāo qiú 。
en: It is difficult to be the director of this company, not only to manage the entire department, but also to meet the job requirements of the boss.

zh: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
py: chén xiān shēng yǒu wǔ gè hái zi ， shēng huó fèi fù dān hěn dà   xiǎo zhāng bù xiǎng zēng jiā fù qīn de fù dān ， wèi le fù dān zì jǐ de xué fèi ， yī xià kè jiù qù dǎ gōng 。
en: Mr. Chen has five children, whose living expenses are very high, and who do not want to increase their father's burden, so as to pay for their studies, he goes to work immediately.

zh: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
py: fù mǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn ài de jiā rén ， shuí dōu bù néng dài tì tā men zài wǒ xīn zhōng de dì wèi 。
en: Parents are my dearest family members, and no one can take their place in my heart.

zh: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
py: wǒ men bǎ kǎo juàn jiāo gěi lǎo shī hòu ， lǎo shī jiù bǎ zhèng què de dá àn gào sù dà jiā 。
en: When we give the test to the teacher, he tells you the right answer.

zh: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
py: wáng tài tài bǎ quán jiā zhào gù dé fēi cháng hǎo ， wáng xiān shēng hěn gǎn xiè tā duì jiā tíng de gòng xiàn   měi gè dà xué shēng bì yè hòu ， dōu yīng gāi wèi shè huì gòng xiàn zì jǐ de zhuān yè néng lì 。
en: Mrs. Wang has taken great care of the family, and Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family, and after graduation, every college student should contribute her professional abilities to society.

zh: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
py: zhè gè guó jiā gōng yuán de fú wù zhōng xīn tí gōng yóu kè jiǎn jiè ， jiè shào gōng yuán de tè sè hé yǒu míng de jǐng diǎn 。
en: The service centre of the National Park offers a guest brief on the characteristics and famous features of the park.

zh: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
py: A: nǐ zhī dào bàn lǐ liú xué de shǒu xù xū yào zhǔn bèi nǎ xiē zī liào ma ？ B: wǒ bù qīng chǔ 。 nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng zhā zhā 。
en: B: I don't know. You can check it online.

zh: 正常的生活作息，對身體和心理健康都很重要。
py: zhèng cháng de shēng huó zuò xī ， duì shēn tǐ hé xīn lǐ jiàn kāng dōu hěn zhòng yào 。
en: A normal life is important for both physical and mental health.

zh: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
py: wèi le fú hé shì chǎng de xū qiú ，「 kuài shí shàng 」 gōng sī bù duàn dì shè jì chū zuì liú xíng de fú zhuāng yàng shì 。
en: In order to meet market demand, Fast Fashion has constantly designed the most popular dress patterns.

zh: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
py: hù lǐ shī gào sù bìng rén ， dé àn sān cān fàn hòu de shí jiān chī yào ， cái néng kuài diǎn huī fù jiàn kāng 。
en: The nurse told the patient to take medication after three meals in order to be able to recover quickly.

zh: 醫生一再警告韓先生絕對不能再喝酒了，要不然他的身體情況就會更糟了。
py: yī shēng yī zài jǐng gào hán xiān shēng jué duì bù néng zài hē jiǔ le ， yào bù rán tā de shēn tǐ qíng kuàng jiù huì gèng zāo le 。
en: The doctor repeatedly warned Mr. Han never to drink again, otherwise his condition would be worse.

zh: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
py: jiǎ rú sǐ le zhēn de néng shàng tiān táng ， wǒ xiǎng rèn hé rén dōu xī wàng néng gòu zài nà lǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yì qǐ 。
en: If death can really go to heaven, I think anyone wants to be there with the loved ones.

zh: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
py: yǒu rén xìn shàng dì ， yǒu rén bù xìn 。 dàn zài dōng xī fāng de wén huà zhōng ，「 shàng dì 」 de jué sè dōu shì hěn zhòng yào de 。
en: Some believe in God, others don't. But in East-West culture, the role of God is important.

zh: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
py: wǒ de fǎ guó péng yǒu zuì chū zhǐ jì huà lái tái wān xué zhōng wén ， méi xiǎng dào hòu lái ná dào le jiǎng xué jīn ， hái niàn le bó shì bān 。
en: My French friend initially planned to study Chinese only in Taiwan, but later he got a scholarship and a doctoral course.

zh: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
py: yào shì nǐ jué dé zhè pán cài de wèi dào tài dàn le ， kě yǐ jiā yī diǎn jiàng liào 。
en: If you think this dish tastes too pale, you can add a little sauce.

zh: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
py: zhè chǎng dà dì zhèn fā shēng hòu bù jiǔ ， jūn rén jiù lì kè gǎn dào le zāi qū ， xié zhù jiù zāi gōng zuò 。
en: Shortly after the earthquake, the military arrived in the disaster area to assist in the rescue effort.

zh: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
py: wáng lǎo bǎn lǎo shì yāo qiú yuán gōng suí shí pèi hé tā kāi huì 、 jiā bān 、 chū chāi ， zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo 。
en: Mr. Wang always asks his staff to cooperate with him whenever he wants, to work overtime, to travel on business, and the realist can't stand it.

zh: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
py: chū guó dāng jiāo huàn xué shēng de mù dì ， bù jǐn jǐn shì wèi le xué xí yǔ yán ， gèng zhòng yào de shì liǎo jiě dāng dì de wén huà 。
en: The purpose of the exchange of students abroad is not only to learn language, but, more importantly, to understand the local culture.

zh: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
py: jīn xiān shēng zuì jìn yù dào le hěn bù xìng de shì ， tā de fù mǔ zài yī chǎng jiāo tōng yì wài zhōng qù shì le 。
en: Mr. King had recently had a very unfortunate experience, and his parents had died in a traffic accident.

zh: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
py: wáng xiǎo jiě yòng wǎng lù jiāo yǒu de fāng shì ， zhǎo dào le lǐ xiǎng de jié hūn duì xiàng 。
en: Miss Wang found the ideal marriage partner by making friends online.

zh: 透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。
py: tòu guò jiào shòu de jiè shào ， wǒ yī bì yè jiù shùn lì dì zhǎo dào le mǎn yì de gōng zuò 。
en: Through the professor's introduction, I managed to find a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated.

zh: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
py: tā bǎ suǒ yǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚ péng yǒu ， zhí dào nǚ péng yǒu bèi jǐng chá zhuā le ， cái zhī dào zì jǐ bèi piàn 。
en: He gave all his money to his girlfriend until she was taken by the police.

zh: 有個騙子吃完了麵，假裝忘記帶錢包，騙老闆要回家拿錢，一離開就沒回來了。
py: yǒu gè piàn zi chī wán le miàn ， jiǎ zhuāng wàng jì dài qián bāo ， piàn lǎo bǎn yào huí jiā ná qián ， yī lí kāi jiù méi huí lái le 。
en: One of the liars, after eating noodles, pretended to forget his wallet and lied to the boss to go home to get the money, and he didn't come back as soon as he left.

zh: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
py: A: duì bù qǐ ， nǐ de bēi zi bèi wǒ dǎ pò le ， wǒ bú shì gù yì de 。 B: méi guān xì ！ hái hǎo nǐ méi shòu shāng 。
en: A: I'm sorry that I broke your cup, and I didn't mean it. B: it's okay. It's good that you're not hurt.

zh: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
py: nà gè lǎo bǎn zuò shēng yì bù lǎo shí ， yī zài gēn kè rén bǎo zhèng shāng pǐn méi wèn tí ， qí shí shì piàn rén de 。
en: The boss's bad business. He promised his customers that the goods would be fine, but it's a lie.

zh: 地球的表面大約百分之七十是水，百分之三十是地。
py: dì qiú de biǎo miàn dà yuē bǎi fēn zhī qī shí shì shuǐ ， bǎi fēn zhī sān shí shì dì 。
en: About 70 percent of the Earth's surface is water and 30 percent is land.

zh: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
py: jīn tiān kāi huì shí ， jīng lǐ biǎo miàn shàng duì lǎo bǎn hěn kè qì ， qí shí xīn lǐ hěn bù gāo xìng 。
en: At today's meeting, the manager appeared to be very polite to the boss, but he was very upset.

zh: 他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
py: tā tòu guò wǎng lù rèn shí le yī wèi wǎng yǒu ， zhí dào jié hūn qián ， tā men cái jiàn guò duì fāng sān cì 。
en: He met an online friend through the Internet and only three times before he got married.

zh: 跟張先生聊天時，總是我問一句，他答一句，真沒意思。
py: gēn zhāng xiān shēng liáo tiān shí ， zǒng shì wǒ wèn yī jù ， tā dá yī jù ， zhēn méi yì si 。
en: When I talk to Mr. Zhang, I always ask, and he answers, it's boring.

zh: A:好久沒看到你父母了，請替我問候他們。 B:沒問題。
py: A: hǎo jiǔ méi kàn dào nǐ fù mǔ le ， qǐng tì wǒ wèn hòu tā men 。 B: méi wèn tí 。
en: A: It's been a long time since I saw your parents.

zh: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
py: dà xué jiào yù de mù dì ， bù jǐn yào tí gāo xué shēng de zhī shí shuǐ zhǔn ， hái yào jìn yī bù péi yǎng xué shēng de zhuān yè néng lì 。
en: The aim of university education is not only to improve students ' knowledge but also to further develop their professional abilities.

zh: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
py: zhè gè lù kǒu hěn wēi xiǎn ， jīng cháng fā shēng chē huò 。
en: It's dangerous. There's a lot of car accidents.

zh: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
py: měi gè rén xīn zhōng dōu yǒu lǐ xiǎng de jiāo yǒu tiáo jiàn ， bǐ rú nián líng jǐ suì yǐ xià ， shēn gāo jǐ gōng fēn yǐ shàng ， dàn wǒ zhǐ yào duì fāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le 。
en: There are ideal dating conditions in every human being, for example, under the age of a few and above a few centimetres, but I just want to love each other.

zh: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
py: yǒu yī fèn yán jiū bào gào biǎo shì ， duì mò shēng huán jìng shì yīng néng lì yuè qiáng de rén ， wèi lái chéng gōng de jī huì yě yuè gāo 。
en: According to a study, the greater the ability to adapt to a strange environment, the greater the chances of success in the future.

zh: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
py: yǒu yī xiē jiāo yǒu wǎng zhàn shàng de gè rén xìng míng 、 nián líng děng zī liào dōu shì jiǎ de ， suǒ yǐ shàng wǎng jiāo yǒu yào xiǎo xīn 。
en: Some of the personal names, ages, etc. on dating sites are false, so be careful online.

zh: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
py: wǒ zhù de dì fāng bù suàn piān pì ， dàn shì fù jìn méi yǒu gōng chē zhàn ， suǒ yǐ zì xíng chē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lì yòng de jiāo tōng gōng jù 。
en: I don't live in remote places, but there's no bus station nearby, so bikes are my most commonly used means of transport.

zh: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
py: zài nà chǎng chē huò zhōng ， nà gè hái zi shī qù le fù mǔ ， jiā lǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī gè rén ， dà jiā dōu hěn tóng qíng tā 。
en: In that accident, the child lost his parents, and he was left alone in the house, and everyone sympathized with him.

zh: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
py: tā shì yī gè chéng shí de hái zi ， zuò cuò shì yí dìng huì yǒng gǎn chéng rèn de 。
en: He's an honest child, and he'll be brave enough to admit what's wrong.

zh: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
py: nà gè wǎng lù shāng diàn jīng cháng mài jiǎ huò ， nǐ kě bié shàng dāng 。
en: That Internet store always sells fakes. Don't be a fool.

zh: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
py: nà gè rén hē le jiǔ hái kāi chē ， jié guǒ zào chéng yán zhòng de chē huò ， hài liǎng gè rén bù xìng sǐ le ， zhēn kě è ！
en: That man was drunk and driving, and he caused a serious car accident, and two people died, damn it!

zh: 從小父母就教導我要做個好人，別讓人看不起自己。
py: cóng xiǎo fù mǔ jiù jiào dǎo wǒ yào zuò gè hǎo rén ， bié ràng rén kàn bù qǐ zì jǐ 。
en: I've been taught to be a good man since I was a kid, so don't make people look down on themselves.

zh: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
py: xiǎo shí hòu yé yé cháng péi wǒ zuò gōng kè 、 jiào wǒ dǎ qiú hé diào yú ， xiàn zài huí xiǎng qǐ nà duàn shí jiān ， gǎn jué zhēn xìng fú 。
en: When I was a kid, my grandfather used to do my homework, teach me how to play and fish, and now remembering that time, he was happy.

zh: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
py: zhè jiā diàn nǎo gōng sī běn lái zhǐ fú wù yà zhōu dì qū de mín zhòng ， xiàn zài fú wù fàn wéi yǐ jīng kuò dà dào ōu zhōu le 。
en: This computer company, which was supposed to serve only people in Asia, has now expanded its reach to Europe.

zh: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
py: xiǎo lǐ hǎo jǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎng yǒu jiàn miàn ， dōu bèi jù jué ， suǒ yǐ bù zài gēn tā lián luò le 。
en: Li refused to meet her online several times, so she stopped contacting her.

zh: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng shì yòng zhēn shí gù shì pāi chéng de ， ràng guān zhòng gǎn jué hěn zhēn shí ， yě hěn gǎn dòng 。
en: The film was made out of real stories that made the audience feel real and touched.

zh: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
py: hé lǎo bǎn tì gōng sī jiàn lì le liáng hǎo de zhì dù ， ràng yuán gōng dōu néng ān xīn dì gōng zuò 。
en: He has put in place a good system for the company so that employees can work safely.

zh: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
py: wǒ zhù de dì fāng hěn piān pì ， shǒu jī cháng shōu bú dào xùn xī ， péng yǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ lián luò 。
en: I live in a remote area, my cell phones don't get messages, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

zh: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
py: nǐ zhī dào dì yī cì shì jiè yùn dòng huì shì zài nǎ lǐ jǔ xíng de ma ？
en: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

zh: 從我加入這個健身社團後，不但作息正常了，身體也更健康了。
py: cóng wǒ jiā rù zhè gè jiàn shēn shè tuán hòu ， bù dàn zuò xī zhèng cháng le ， shēn tǐ yě gèng jiàn kāng le 。
en: Since I joined this gym, it's not only normal, it's healthier.

zh: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
py: tòu guò shè qún wǎng zhàn ， wǒ men kě yǐ jiā rù gǎn xìng qù de shè tuán ， ràng zì jǐ de shēng huó gèng chōng shí 。
en: Through social networks, we can join interested groups to make our lives more productive.

zh: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
py: nà jiā gōng chǎng zì cóng gǎi shàn le shè bèi yǐ hòu ， shēng chǎn sù dù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le 。
en: Since the plant improved its equipment, the production rate has been faster every day.

zh: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
py: xiàn dài gè shì gè yàng de kē jì chǎn pǐn ， ràng rén men de shēng huó gèng shū shì 、 biàn lì   zhè jiā lǚ guǎn měi gè fáng jiān dōu shè jì dé hěn xiàn dài ， xī yǐn bù shǎo nián qīng rén lái dìng fáng 。
en: Today's technology products of all kinds make life easier and easier for people, and every room in the hotel is modern and attracts a lot of young people to book.

zh: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
py: zhǐ yào zhào wēn lǎo shī ān pái de kè chéng ， duō yuè dú 、 duō liàn xí ， nǐ de zhōng wén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìn bù 。
en: As long as you follow the teacher's schedule, read more and practice more, your Chinese language will make great progress.

zh: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
py: wǒ bó bo shuō ， dú shū yǔ zuò rén tóng yàng zhòng yào ， yě shì yī bèi zi de shì   yǔ rén gōu tōng shí ， zuì zhòng yào de shì ràng duì fāng qīng chǔ liǎo jiě nǐ xiǎng biǎo dá de yì si 。
en: My uncle said that reading is as important as being a human being, and it's also a lifetime of communication with people, and it's important for each other to know what you're trying to say.

zh: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
py: A: yào bú shì nǐ bāng máng ， xiàn zài wǒ hái zhǎo bú dào gōng zuò ne ！ B: méi shén me ， péng yǒu zhī jiān běn lái jiù yīng gāi hù xiāng bāng zhù 。
en: A: If you didn't help me, I wouldn't be able to find a job. B: Nothing. Friends should have helped each other.

zh: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
py: xǔ jīng lǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhí de wǒ men xué xí ， dì yī diǎn shì zuò shì zǎi xì ， dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nài xīn   nǐ de bái chèn shān shàng miàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn ， kuài tuō xià lái ， wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ 。
en: The manager has two things to learn. The first is to do things very carefully. The second is to be patient with a black spot on your white shirt. Take it off. I'll wash it for you.

zh: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
py: wǒ shì jīn dōng xián de xì mí ， jīn tiān zhōng yú kàn dào tā běn rén ， shí zài tài kāi xīn le 。
en: I'm Kim Dong-hyun's fan and I'm so happy to see him today.

zh: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
py: nǐ men zhī jiān de wù huì yuè lái yuè shēn ， yào shì bù miàn duì miàn shuō qīng chǔ ， kǒng pà lián péng yǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le   xià kè yǐ hòu ， lǎo shī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔ xí shù xué ， xī wàng wǒ de qī mò kǎo huì jí gé   zuó tiān de ōu zhōu zú qiú sài ， fǎ guó duì yì dà lì de bǐ sài zhēn shì tài cì jī le 。
en: The misunderstanding between you is getting deeper and deeper, and I'm afraid even my friends are not going to be able to learn math on a one-to-one basis, and I hope that my final exam will pass yesterday's European football match, and that France's competition against Italy will be so exciting.

zh: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
py: jiǎn lǎo bǎn yīn wèi shēng yì de guān xì ， jīng cháng jiē chù yuè nán rén ， xiāng dāng liǎo jiě liǎng guó zhī jiān gōng zuò xí guàn de chà yì 。
en: Mr. Jane, because of his business relationship, has frequent contacts with Vietnamese and has a good understanding of the differences in working habits between the two countries.

zh: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
py: rén rén dōu xī wàng zì jǐ de hái zi yǒu xìng fú de shēng huó 、 měi hǎo de wèi lái 。
en: Everyone wants a happy life and a good future for their children.

zh: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
py: wǒ děng yí xià yào kāi huì ， bù fāng biàn jiē diàn huà ， yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒu jī chuán xùn xī gěi wǒ 。
en: I have a meeting later. If I can't pick up the phone, give me a message on my cell phone.

zh: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
py: dāng wǒ yù dào cuò zhé shí ， tā zǒng shì xié zhù wǒ kè fú kùn nán ， wǒ men zhī jiān yě jiàn lì le zhēn guì de yǒu yì 。
en: When I was frustrated, he always helped me overcome my difficulties, and we built a precious friendship.

zh: 林阿姨來我家推銷保險，我不好意思當面拒絕她，只好假裝有急事要出門。
py: lín ā yí lái wǒ jiā tuī xiāo bǎo xiǎn ， wǒ bù hǎo yì sī dāng miàn jù jué tā ， zhǐ hǎo jiǎ zhuāng yǒu jí shì yào chū mén 。
en: Aunt Lin came to my house to sell insurance, and I was embarrassed to turn her down in person and pretended to have an emergency.

zh: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
py: xué shēng yǔ xiào zhǎng dāng miàn duì huà ， xī wàng xué jiào gǎi shàn jiào xué shè bèi hé xiào yuán cān tīng de fú wù pǐn zhì   tīng dào lǎo bǎn gēn jīng lǐ de duì huà ， wǒ cái zhī dào gōng sī xīn chǎn pǐn de xiāo shòu chéng jī bù lǐ xiǎng 。
en: When students and school principals face up to each other, they want schools to improve the quality of their teaching facilities and the services of the campus restaurant   to hear the conversation between the boss and the manager, so that I know that the sales results of the company’s new products are not ideal.

zh: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
py: tā zuì jìn duì nǐ shuō huà de tài dù biàn dé lěng dàn ， nǐ men zhī jiān shì bú shì yǒu shén me wù huì ？
en: Has there been a misunderstanding between you?

zh: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
py: qián jǐ tiān yīn wèi tái fēng de guān xì ， zào chéng bù fèn dì qū yán zhòng yān shuǐ ， xǔ duō shū guǒ de jià gé dōu biàn gāo le 。
en: The previous few days had been marked by severe flooding in parts of the region as a result of the hurricane, and the price of many vegetables and vegetables had become higher.

zh: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
py: chū guó liú xué yǒu bù shǎo hǎo chù ， lì rú dǎ kāi shì yě 、 zēng jiā zì xìn 、 tí gāo wài wén chéng dù děng děng 。
en: There are a number of advantages to studying abroad, such as opening eyes, increasing self-confidence, raising the level of foreign languages, and so on.

zh: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
py: mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān ， nǐ huì zhǎo dào xīn zhōng zuì lǐ xiǎng de jié hūn duì xiàng ， xiàn zài bié jí 。
en: One day of a year, one month, you'll find the ideal marriage partner in your heart. Now, don't worry.

zh: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
py: nà duì shuāng bāo tāi zhǎng dé hěn xiàng ， gè xìng què hěn bù tóng ， gē gē hěn dà fāng ， dì di hěn hài xiū 。
en: The twins looked alike, but their personality was very different, their brother was very generous and their brother was very shy.

zh: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
py: hé xiān shēng zǎo jiù xí guàn le dān shēn shēng huó ， yī diǎn dōu bù xiǎng jié hūn 。
en: Mr. Ho is used to living alone and doesn't want to get married at all.

zh: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
py: xiǎo zhāng yǐ jīng jié hūn le ， hái cháng cháng gēn qí tā nǚ shēng yuē huì ， zhēn shì tài huā xīn le 。
en: It's too much for him to be married and to go out with other girls.

zh: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
py: lì lì de lǎo gōng zài tā shēng rì nà tiān ， sòng le tā jiǔ shí jiǔ duǒ méi guī huā ， hǎo làng màn a ！
en: Lily's husband gave her 99 roses on her birthday. It's so romantic!

zh: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
py: rén rén dōu kě wàng làng màn de ài qíng hé xìng fú de jiā tíng ， bù guò zì yóu zì zài de dān shēn shēng huó yě shì bù cuò de 。
en: Everyone yearns for romantic love and a happy family, but a free, single life is also good.

zh: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
py: mā mā shēng bìng shí ， xiǎo huá gěi jiā rén zuò fàn 、 zhào gù dì di mèi mèi ， zhēn shì gè dǒng shì de hái zi 。
en: When her mother was sick, she was a good kid who cooks for her family and takes care of her brother and sister.

zh: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
py: shí jīng lǐ duì yuán gōng hěn xiōng ， huí jiā hòu què néng biǎo xiàn chū wēn róu de yí miàn ， fēi cháng tǐ tiē tài tài 。
en: Ishishi was very aggressive towards the staff, but when she returned home, she showed a gentle face and was very kind to her wife.

zh: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
py: lǎo pó ： wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòu jiāng ， zěn me mǎi le wú táng de ， zhēn nán hē ！  lǎo gōng ： nǐ yòu méi shuō qīng chǔ ， zěn me néng guài wǒ 。
en: Honey: I told you to buy soy sauce, how can you buy sugarless? Honey: How can you blame me if you didn't make it clear?

zh: 我知道那輛德國汽車很貴，至於到底多貴，我就不清楚了。
py: wǒ zhī dào nà liàng dé guó qì chē hěn guì ， zhì yú dào dǐ duō guì ， wǒ jiù bù qīng chǔ le 。
en: I know how expensive that German car is, and I don't know how expensive it is.

zh: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
py: yì bān lái shuō ， fù mǔ zài hái zi de xīn zhōng shì zuì wěi dà de ， méi yǒu rén kě yǐ qǔ dài 。
en: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in the child ' s mind and no one can replace them.

zh: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
py: yǒu le wú xiàn wǎng lù ， jiù kě yǐ suí shí suí dì shàng wǎng chá zī liào 、 kàn yǐng piàn ， huò shì wán yóu xì 。
en: Wireless networks allow access to data, videos or games whenever they are available.

zh: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
py: nà bān fēi jī yīn wèi tiān qì de guān xì ， méi bàn fǎ zhǔn shí dǐ dá   zǒng tǒng dǐ dá xīn wén shuō míng huì de xiàn chǎng qián ， ān quán rén yuán dé xiān què rèn jì zhě de zī liào ， hái dé jiǎn chá tā men de bēi bāo 。
en: Because of the weather, the plane could not arrive on time before President `br' arrived at the press conference, and the security officers had to verify the reporters' data and check their backpacks.

zh: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
py: dì di yīn wèi míng tiān yào qù dà xué miàn shì ， jǐn zhāng dé zhěng gè wǎn shàng dōu shuì bù hǎo   wèi le zhǔn bèi zhè cì de miàn shì ， wǒ kàn le hěn duō xiāng guān zī liào ， hái bù duàn dì liàn xí miàn shì shí gēn zhǔ guǎn de duì huà 。
en: My brother was nervous about going to college tomorrow and couldn't sleep all night to prepare for the interview, and I read a lot about it, and I kept practicing with the supervisor.

zh: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
py: A: nín hǎo ， huān yíng nín lái miàn shì 。 qǐng wèn guì xìng ？ B: nín hǎo ， wǒ xìng tóng ， hěn gāo xìng jīn tiān néng dào guì gōng sī lái miàn shì 。
en: A: Welcome to the interview. What's your last name? B: Hello, I'm a child. It's good to see you at your company today.

zh: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
py: zài nǐ de guó jiā ， dì yī cì bàn lǐ hù zhào dé běn rén qīn zì qù ， bù néng qǐng bié rén dài tì ma ？
en: In your country, you have to take your first passport yourself. Can't you hire someone else to replace you?

zh: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
py: míng tiān de zhǔ guǎn huì yì zài sān lóu de huì yì shì jǔ xíng ， jīng lǐ yāo qiú dà jiā bú yào chí dào 。
en: Tomorrow's meeting is held on the third floor in the conference room, and the manager asks that everyone not be late.

zh: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
py: jiǎ rú guì gōng sī xiǎng kuò dà shēng chǎn guī mó ， kě yǐ cān kǎo běn gōng sī de zuò fǎ ， wǒ men hěn yuàn yì tí gōng xié zhù 。
en: If your company wants to expand the scale of production, we can take into account our own practices, and we would be happy to assist.

zh: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
py: A: duì zhè cì xīn chǎn pǐn de xiāo shòu fāng shì ， nǐ yǒu shén me xiǎng fǎ ？ B: wǒ zài zhè fāng miàn méi shén me jīng yàn ， nǐ kě yǐ qù qǐng jiào fāng jīng lǐ 。
en: A: What do you think of the way this new product is sold? B: I have no experience in this area. You can ask the manager.

zh: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
py: nà gè diàn yuán de gōng zuò tài dù hěn suí biàn ， cháng nòng cuò shāng pǐn de jià gé ， hái zhǎo cuò qián ，  zhēn shì tài kuā zhāng le ！
en: The guy's casual, he's wrong about the price of the goods, he's wrong about the money, it's ridiculous!

zh: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
py: bù shǎo rén pī píng nà jiā jiàn shēn zhōng xīn jiào liàn de jiào xué pǐn zhì hěn chà ， yǐ hòu jué duì bù huì zài qù le 。
en: There were many criticisms of the poor quality of the trainer at the gym and he would never go back.

zh: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
py: fāng lǎo shī fēi cháng yǒu nài xīn ， jiù suàn xué shēng kǎo shì de chéng jī hěn zāo ， yě cóng lái méi fā guò pí qì 。
en: Mr. Fang was very patient and had never been angry, even if the student test results were bad.

zh: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
py: dà duō shù de rén rèn wèi zhé xué shì yī mén hěn nán de xué wèn ， bù róng yì lǐ jiě   xiān shēng de gè xìng hěn qí guài ， yòu ài luàn fā pí qì ， chú le tā lǎo pó ， méi rén néng lǐ jiě tā 。
en: Most people think philosophy is a hard lesson to learn, and it's not easy to understand Mr. br's strange personality, and he's angry, and no one understands him except his wife.

zh: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
py: suī rán lán xiān shēng shì dà xué de xiào zhǎng ， kě shì tā hěn qiān xū ， jīng cháng xiàng tóng shì qǐng jiào guǎn lǐ xué xiào de fāng fǎ 。
en: Although Mr. Lang was the head of the university, he was modest and often asked his colleagues to teach him how to run the school.

zh: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
py: měi dāng bāo tài tài xīn qíng bù hǎo de shí hòu ， bāo xiān shēng jiù huì shuō xiào huà lái dòu tā ， ràng tā kāi xīn yī diǎn 。
en: When Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao makes jokes and makes her happy.

zh: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
py: duì huá rén lái shuō ， bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měi hǎo de wèi lái ， zhè gè chuán tǒng guān niàn zài tái wān yǐ jīng màn màn gǎi biàn le 。
en: For the Chinese, the tradition of reading well for a better future has slowly changed in Taiwan.

zh: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
py: xiàn dài rén wǎng wǎng yǐ wǎng lù chuán xùn xī ， dài tì chuán tǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diàn huà de fāng shì 。
en: Modern people often transmit messages on the Internet in lieu of traditional correspondence or telephone calls.

zh: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
py: yì xiān shēng cóng zhí chǎng tuì xiū hòu ， jiù jiā rù le yī yuàn de fú wù shè tuán ， jì xù wèi shè huì gòng xiàn yī fèn lì liàng 。
en: After his retirement, Mr. Yi joined the hospital service group and continued to contribute to society.

zh: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
py: guǎn xiān shēng zhè duàn shí jiān máng zhù bù zhì xīn fáng zi ， xī wàng gěi lǎo pó yī gè yòu shū shì yòu wēn nuǎn de jiā 。
en: I don't care if Mr. has been busy setting up a new house and wants to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

zh: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng yī xǐng lái jiù qù shuā yá 、 xǐ liǎn ， rán hòu qù fù jìn guó xiǎo de cāo chǎng pǎo bù 。
en: I wake up every morning and brush my teeth, wash my face, and then run to a small playground nearby.

zh: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
py: lǎo shī bǎ ān yǎng yuàn shè tuán de shè yuán fēn chéng liǎng gè xiǎo zǔ ， dì yī zǔ péi lǎo rén chàng gē ，  dì èr zǔ péi lǎo rén wán yóu xì 。
en: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home group into two groups, the first group singing with the elderly and the second group playing games with the elderly.

zh: 我父親是個警察，只要他負責的小組有重要任務時，就得出差一兩個星期。
py: wǒ fù qīn shì gè jǐng chá ， zhǐ yào tā fù zé de xiǎo zǔ yǒu zhòng yào rèn wù shí ， jiù dé chū chāi yī liǎng gè xīng qī 。
en: My father was a police officer who had to travel for a week or two as long as his team had an important mission.

zh: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
py: A: yào shì nǐ fā xiàn nán péng yǒu duì nǐ yuè lái yuè lěng dàn ， hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎng yǒu yuē huì ，  nǐ huì yuán liàng tā ma ？ B: zhè me huā xīn de nán rén ， jué duì bù zhí dé yuán liàng 。
en: A: Would you forgive your boyfriend if he found out that he was getting colder with you and used to date a woman online? B: A man like this is absolutely unforgivable.

zh: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
py: jié hūn zhī qián ， nà duì qíng lǚ rèn zhēn guī huà le wèi lái de shēng huó ， méi xiǎng dào jié hūn yī gè yuè zhī hòu jiù lí hūn le 。
en: Before the marriage, the couple planned the future without expecting a month after the marriage to be divorced.

zh: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
py: shāng xiān shēng cóng bù fā pí qì ， rén yě hěn qiān xū ， bù lùn bié rén zěn me pī píng tā ， tā hái shì hěn kè qì dì shuō xiè xiè 。
en: He was not angry, he was modest, and no matter how others criticized him, he was kind enough to say thank you.

zh: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
py: shǐ xiǎo jiě zuò shì hěn xì xīn ， zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎn chá guò hǎo jǐ cì ， hái shì bèi tā fā xiàn le jǐ gè cuò zì 。
en: Miss Strozzi was very careful. I checked this watch several times, and she found out a few wrong words.

zh: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
py: yán xiǎo jiě de zhí chǎng biǎo xiàn hěn yōu xiù ， chú le wài wén néng lì hǎo ， zuò shì yě hěn xì xīn 。
en: Ms. Yin's career was excellent, and in addition to her ability to speak English, she was very careful.

zh: 人人都喜歡薪水高、離家近、輕鬆的工作，不過這往往只是一個夢。
py: rén rén dōu xǐ huān xīn shuǐ gāo 、 lí jiā jìn 、 qīng sōng de gōng zuò ， bù guò zhè wǎng wǎng zhǐ shì yī gè mèng 。
en: Everyone likes high-paying, near-home, light jobs, but it's often just a dream.

zh: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī fú lì bù cuò ， měi nián chú le tí gōng miǎn fèi jiàn jiǎn ， lǎo bǎn hái huì dài yuán gōng chū guó lǚ yóu 。
en: The company benefits well and every year, in addition to providing free health checks, the boss takes workers abroad.

zh: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
py: yǒu guān zhè chǎng huǒ zāi de xiáng xì qíng kuàng ， děng diào chá jié guǒ chū lái yǐ hòu ， shì zhǎng huì xiàng mín zhòng bào gào 。
en: The mayor will report the details of the fire to the public when the results of the investigation come out.

zh: 剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。
py: gāng jìn gōng sī de yuán gōng duì huán jìng bǐ jiào mò shēng ， duì gōng zuò nèi róng yě bù shú xī ， duō duō shǎo shǎo xū yào xié zhù 。
en: Newcomers are unfamiliar with the environment, unfamiliar with the content of their work, and need more or less help.

zh: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
py: wǒ dǎ gōng de cān tīng yī dào zhōu mò jiù kè mǎn ， máng bù guò lái de shí hòu ， lián lǎo bǎn de shū shū dōu dé lái bāng máng 。
en: I work in a restaurant full of people all weekend, and even my boss's uncle has to help when I can't make it.

zh: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
py: zhè cì yà zhōu wén huà zhǎn ， chú le lè qì biǎo yǎn ， hái yǒu chuán tǒng fú zhuāng shì chuān huó dòng ， huān yíng gè wèi lái cān guān 。
en: In addition to musical performances, there is a traditional dress tryout, and you are welcome to visit.

zh: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
py: nǐ tīng le yóu lǎo bǎn yǒng gǎn kè fú kùn nán 、 jiān chí dào dǐ de zhēn shí gù shì ， yǒu shén me gǎn xiǎng ？
en: How do you feel when you hear the true story of Yo boss, brave enough to overcome his difficulties and stay the course?

zh: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
py: xiàn dài qǐ yè yuè lái yuè zhòng shì yuán gōng de fú lì hé jiàn kāng ， lì rú tí gōng miǎn fèi de lǚ yóu hé jiàn jiǎn 。
en: Modern businesses increasingly focus on the welfare and health of workers, such as providing free travel and health checks.

zh: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
py: fù mǔ sòng wǒ de jié hūn lǐ wù hěn zhēn guì ， bāo hán le tā men duì wǒ mǎn mǎn de zhù fú 。
en: My parents gave me a precious wedding present containing their full blessing.

zh: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
py: jǐn guǎn yé yé qù shì hěn jiǔ le ， dàn měi cì kàn dào zhào piān ， jiù huì huí xiǎng qǐ tā kāi xīn péi wǒ wán de yàng zi 。
en: Even though Grandpa died a long time ago, every time he saw a picture, he remembered how happy he was to play with me.

zh: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
py: wǒ mèi mèi hěn huì zuò jiā shì ， tā zǒng shì bǎ fáng jiān zhěng lǐ dé hěn zhěng qí ， lián chuāng hù yě cā dé hěn qián jìng 。
en: My sister's a good housekeeper. She always cleans up the room and cleans the windows.

zh: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
py: bù zhī dào míng zhé jīn tiān zěn me le ？ lǎo shī jiào le tā hǎo jǐ cì ， tā jiù xiàng mù tóu yī yàng ， méi yǒu fǎn yīng   jiǔ èr yī dà dì zhèn fā shēng dé tài tū rán ， bù shǎo mín zhòng yīn wèi lái bù jí fǎn yīng ， ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ 。
en: I don't know what happened to Ming Chul today. The teacher called him several times, and he didn't react, like a log, to the suddenness of the 925 earthquake, and many people were trapped in the house because they were unable to respond.

zh: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
py: nǐ máng bù guò lái de shí hòu jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāng máng ， bié ràng zì jǐ lèi huài le 。
en: You should get help when you can't. Don't make yourself tired.

zh: 那個店員只顧著玩手機，客人來了都不知道。
py: nà gè diàn yuán zhǐ gù zhù wán shǒu jī ， kè rén lái le dōu bù zhī dào 。
en: The guy's just playing with his cell phone, and the guests don't even know they're here.

zh: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
py: A: wèi shén me huó dòng zhōng xīn lián yī gè rén dōu méi yǒu ？ jīn tiān bú shì yǒu jí tā shè de biǎo yǎn ma ？ B: nǐ gǎo cuò le ， yǎn chū rì qī shì xià gè xīng qī sān 。
en: A: Why is there no one in the center? Isn't there a guitar show today? B: You're mistaken. The show is next Wednesday.

zh: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
py: zhè liǎng gè guó jiā yīn wèi qiǎng shí yóu zī yuán ， ér bǎ duì fāng dāng chéng le dí rén 。
en: The two countries are treating each other as enemies because they rob oil resources.

zh: 「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。
py: 「 zǒng tǒng 」 shì guó jiā zuì gāo lǐng dǎo rén ， tā lǐng dǎo quán guó mín zhòng wǎng qián zǒu ， ràng guó jiā yuè lái yuè jìn bù 。
en: The “President” is the highest leader of the country, and he leads the entire nation forward, making it even more progressive.

zh: 總統對國家的貢獻很大，全國民眾都很尊敬他。
py: zǒng tǒng duì guó jiā de gòng xiàn hěn dà ， quán guó mín zhòng dōu hěn zūn jìng tā 。
en: The President has contributed a great deal to the country, and the people of the country respect him.

zh: 有人說，這個世界是上帝創造的，你相信嗎？
py: yǒu rén shuō ， zhè gè shì jiè shì shàng dì chuàng zào de ， nǐ xiāng xìn ma ？
en: Some say the world was created by God. Can you believe it?

zh: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
py: zhè gè gǎi shàn kōng qì pǐn zhì de jì huà ， yǐ jīng shí xíng sān nián le ， hái xū yào yī duàn shí jiān cái néng kàn dào chéng guǒ 。
en: The project to improve the quality of the air has been in place for three years, and it will take some time to see results.

zh: 這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。
py: zhè gè dì qū de jiāo tōng fēi cháng hùn luàn ， yóu qí shì chē duō rén duō de shàng xià bān shí jiān 。
en: The traffic in the area is very confusing, especially with regard to the large number of people travelling to and from work.

zh: 李導演付出了十年的時間，終於拍出了一部好電影，得到大家的肯定。
py: lǐ dǎo yǎn fù chū le shí nián de shí jiān ， zhōng yú pāi chū le yī bù hǎo diàn yǐng ， dé dào dà jiā de kěn dìng 。
en: For 10 years, Director Lee finally made a good film, which you all recognized.

zh: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
py: dù xiān shēng shì sān jiā wǎng lù shāng diàn de zhǔ guǎn ， tā xī wàng jiāng lái néng dāng dà qǐ yè de lǎo bǎn ， yōng yǒu zì jǐ de shì yè 。
en: Mr. Doo is the head of three Internet shops and he hopes to be the owner of the big business in the future and to have his own business.

zh: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
py: xué shēng ： míng tiān jiù yào dà xué kǎo shì le ， wǒ hěn jǐn zhāng ， pà kǎo bù hǎo 。  lǎo shī ： nǐ shì hěn yōu xiù de xué shēng ， wǒ xiāng xìn zhǐ yào jǐn zì jǐ de néng lì ， hǎo hǎo fā huī shí lì ， yí dìng méi wèn tí de 。
en: Student: I'm nervous about the university exam tomorrow. Teacher: You're a very good student, and I'm sure you'll be fine if you do what you can.

zh: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
py: xiǎo míng shùn lì tōng guò le dà xué kǎo shì ， jīn nián jiù shì yī nián jí de xīn shēng le 。
en: Ming managed to pass the university exam, and this year he's a freshman in the first grade.

zh: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
py: xiǎo zhāng yǐ jīng sì shí suì le ， fù mǔ pàn wàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎo dào jié hūn duì xiàng ， tā què yī diǎn yě bù zhù jí 。
en: Zhang is 40 years old, and his parents expect him to find someone to marry soon, but he's not in any hurry.

zh: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
py: gōng sī de huì yì zī liào dōu cún zài yún duān ， zhè yàng yòu ān quán yòu fāng biàn ， gè bù mén yě néng suí shí cān kǎo 。
en: The company ' s meeting data is cloudy, so that it is safe and convenient and the ministries can refer to it at any time.

zh: 太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。
py: tài tài ： nǐ hē zuì le ， bié zài hē le 。  xiān shēng ： hǎo la ， hǎo la ， hái shèng xià yī kǒu ， hē wán jiù bù hē le 。
en: Ma'am: You're drunk, don't drink anymore.

zh: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
py: zhè cì shì jiè yùn dòng huì de yì bǎi gōng chǐ sài pǎo ， měi guó yùn dòng yuán pǎo chū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jì lù   lǎo shī bǎ xué shēng měi cì kǎo shì de fēn shù jì lù xià lái ， zhè yàng jiù néng zhī dào xué shēng shì bú shì jìn bù le 。
en: One hundred meters of the World Games, and the American athletes ran out of a new 9:37 second record, Mr. B. wrote down the students' scores for each test, so that we could see if the students were making progress.

zh: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
py: yǐ diàn nǎo xì tǒng qǔ dài chuán tǒng shōu tíng chē fèi de fāng shì ， néng bāng lǎo bǎn jié shěng gōng zuò rén yuán de fèi yòng 。
en: The use of computer systems to replace traditional parking fees can help the owners to save the costs of their employees.

zh: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
py: nà jiā diàn de mén shì zì dòng de ， zhǐ yào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zì dòng dǎ kāi   zhè dòng dà lóu yǒu ān quán xì tǒng de shè bèi ， xiǎo tōu jìn qù jiù huì zì dòng fā chū jǐng gào de shēng yīn tōng zhī jǐng chá 。
en: The door of the store is automatic, the building will automatically be opened in front of the door with a security system and the thief will enter and the police will be informed of the sound of an automatic warning.

zh: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
py: jì xiān shēng de bù luò gé yōng yǒu bù shǎo dú zhě ， xià gè zhōu mò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīn shū huó dòng ， mǎi le xīn shū de dú zhě dōu kě yǐ qǐng tā qiān míng 。
en: Mr. Chee's blog has a lot of readers, he's going to have a new book event next weekend, and anyone who buys a new book can ask him to sign it.

zh: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
py: gōng yuán fù jìn de tíng chē chǎng hái hěn kōng ， nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nà lǐ qù 。
en: The parking lot near the park is still empty. You can park there.

zh: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
py: mā mā bǎ fàng zài yuàn zi lǐ de yī duī kōng píng zi 、 kōng guàn zi dōu rēng le   jīn tiān de zuò yè shì xiě yī piān zuò wén ， kě shì wǒ de nǎo zi kōng kōng de ， yī gè zì yě xiě bù chū lái 。
en: Mom threw a bunch of empty bottles and empty cans in the yard to write a writing today, but it was empty of my mind and not a word.

zh: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
py: yì bān lái shuō ， miàn shì shí yào zhǔn bèi de xiāng guān wén jiàn bāo kuò gè rén jī běn zī liào 、 bì yè zhèng shū děng děng 。
en: Generally, the documents to be prepared for the interview include personal basics, diplomas, etc.

zh: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
py: lù jiào shòu zài zì jǐ de wǎng zhàn shàng fā biǎo yǒu guān jiào xué hé yán jiū de chéng guǒ ， xiāng dāng zhí de cān kǎo 。
en: Professor Lu's presentation of the results of teaching and research on his website is quite interesting.

zh: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
py: wǒ měi tiān shuì jué qián dōu huì bǎ míng tiān de zǎo cān yù bèi hǎo ， zhè yàng yì qǐ chuáng zhǐ yào jiā rè jiù néng chī le 。
en: I'll be ready for breakfast every day before I go to bed, so we can eat together if we heat up.

zh: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
py: wǒ méi gǎn shàng zuì hòu yī bān gōng chē ， zhè xià zi zhǐ hǎo dā jì chéng chē huí jiā le  A: zāo le ， wǒ bù xiǎo xīn bǎ suí shēn dié nòng diū le ， zī liào dōu cún zài lǐ miàn 。 B: zhè xià zi wǒ men de qī mò bào gào dōu bái zuò le 。
en: I didn't catch the last bus, so I had to take a taxi home  A: Shit, I accidentally lost the disk and the data was in it. B: This is all for nothing.

zh: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
py: wèi le tí gāo yīng wén de tīng lì shuǐ píng ， wǒ chú le tīng shōu yīn jī de yīng wén guǎng bō ， yě huì kàn měi guó de diàn shì xīn wén 。
en: In order to improve the English language, I will also watch American television news in addition to listening to the English radio.

zh: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
py: zì cóng yǒu le gāo sù tiě lù ， bù jǐn suō duǎn le jiāo tōng shí jiān ， rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jù lí yě biàn jìn le 。
en: Since the availability of high-speed railways, not only has traffic time been shortened, but also the distance between people has become closer.

zh: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
py: míng tiān de huì yì zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng shàng chuán dào yún duān ， qǐng gè wèi kāi huì qián xiān liǎo jiě yào tǎo lùn de nèi róng 。
en: I have uploaded the data of tomorrow's meeting to the cloud, and I would like to ask you to know what you want to discuss before you start the meeting.

zh: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
py: fāng xiǎo jiě jì huó pō yòu piào liàng ， nán guài bù shǎo nán shēng xiǎng zhuī qiú tā 。
en: Miss Fang is both lively and beautiful, so that's why a lot of boys want to go after her.

zh: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
py: yǒu yī xiē wǎng lù shàng de zī liào huò yǐng piàn shì bèi bǎo hù de ， bù néng suí biàn xià zài 。
en: Some online data or videos are protected and cannot be downloaded randomly.

zh: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
py: A: wǒ tài hú tú le ， wàng le bǎ biàn gèng hòu de wǎng lù yín xíng mì mǎ jì xià lái 。 B: zhè xià zi nǐ dé qīn zì qù yín xíng chù lǐ le 。
en: A: I'm so confused that I forgot to write down the changed Internet bank code. B: You're gonna have to go to the bank and deal with it yourself.

zh: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
py: lǎo shī xiān bǎ gēn kè chéng xiāng guān de xué xí zī liào shàng chuán dào yún duān ， ràng xué shēng yù xí 。
en: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud to allow students to study.

zh: 這支手機的照相功能很強，拍出來的效果比照相機還要好。
py: zhè zhī shǒu jī de zhào xiàng gōng néng hěn qiáng ， pāi chū lái de xiào guǒ bǐ zhào xiàng jī hái yào hǎo 。
en: This phone has a better photo function than the camera.

zh: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
py: A: tīng shuō xiǎo jīn lí hūn le ， nǐ zhī dào shì zěn me huí shì ma ？ B: āi ， zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐ lái dōu yào guài xiǎo jīn ， shuí jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚ shēng ne ！
en: A: You know what happened when Kim got divorced? B: Alas, it's all about Kim. Who taught him to fall in love with other girls?

zh: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
py: shǐ jiào shòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎo jiě bǎo hù dì qiú huán jìng yǒu duō zhòng yào ， jīng cháng dào gè dì qù yǎn jiǎng 。
en: Professor Strozzi, in order to make more people aware of the importance of protecting the Earth's environment, has often gone to various places to make speeches.

zh: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
py: xiǎo jiǎn jīn tiān yù dào yǐ qián de nǚ péng yǒu ， gēn tā hē le kā fēi cái huí jiā ， dàn bù gǎn gēn tài tài shuō shí huà 。
en: Jane met her old girlfriend today and had coffee with her before she came home, but was afraid to tell her the truth.

zh: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
py: shí dài jìn bù le ， nǚ rén zài jiā tíng hé shè huì zhōng de dì wèi yě gēn zhù tí gāo le   zài gǔ dài zhōng guó ， nán rén bù yīng gāi jìn chú fáng de chuán tǒng guān niàn ， yě yīn wèi shí dài de gǎi biàn ér bù tóng 。
en: The times have evolved and the position of women in the family and society has increased in ancient China, where men are not supposed to enter the kitchen tradition and are different because of the changes in time.

zh: 連先生很年輕的時候就當了國小校長，當年他才三十歲。
py: lián xiān shēng hěn nián qīng de shí hòu jiù dāng le guó xiǎo xiào zhǎng ， dāng nián tā cái sān shí suì 。
en: Mr. Even was a junior headmaster when he was very young, and he was only 30 years old.

zh: 這本中文教材是網路書店出版的，你得上網才買得到。
py: zhè běn zhōng wén jiào cái shì wǎng lù shū diàn chū bǎn de ， nǐ dé shàng wǎng cái mǎi dé dào 。
en: This Chinese textbook is published in an online bookshop, and you have to go online to get it.

zh: 這本小說是以愛情的題材寫成的，後來被拍成了一部浪漫的電影。
py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō shì yǐ ài qíng de tí cái xiě chéng de ， hòu lái bèi pāi chéng le yī bù làng màn de diàn yǐng 。
en: The novel was written on the subject of love, and then it was made into a romantic film.

zh: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
py: wǎng lù shāng diàn mǎn zú le rén men gòu wù de xū qiú ， jiù shì bù chū mén ， yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēng huó yòng pǐn 。
en: The Internet store meets the demand for people to buy, either out of the house or with a variety of living items.

zh: 對現代人來說，電腦和網路絕對是辦公室的主要設備。
py: duì xiàn dài rén lái shuō ， diàn nǎo hé wǎng lù jué duì shì bàn gōng shì de zhǔ yào shè bèi 。
en: Computers and the Internet are absolutely the main equipment of the office for the modern generation.

zh: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
py: gǔ xiān shēng hěn zhòng shì huán bǎo ， gòu wù shí huì zhǔn bèi huán bǎo dài ， zài cān tīng chī fàn yě huì yòng huán bǎo kuài 。
en: Mr. Gu is very concerned about environmental protection, and he prepares environmental bags for shopping, and he uses environmental chopsticks for eating in restaurants.

zh: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
py: xiàn zài de diàn nǎo chù lǐ zī liào de sù dù bǐ yǐ wǎng kuài dé duō ， gōng néng yě gèng duō le 。
en: Computers now process data much faster and more functional.

zh: 畢業當天，許多學生帶著攝影機在校園裡攝影，留下了珍貴的回憶。
py: bì yè dāng tiān ， xǔ duō xué shēng dài zhù shè yǐng jī zài xiào yuán lǐ shè yǐng ， liú xià le zhēn guì de huí yì 。
en: On graduation, many students took pictures of the school with cameras, leaving precious memories.

zh: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
py: nà gè wài guó rén dì yī cì lái tái wān jiù pèng shàng le dà dì zhèn ， ràng tā fēi cháng nán wàng 。
en: The foreigner came to Taiwan for the first time and had a great earthquake, which made him very unforgettable.

zh: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
py: guó jiā tú shū guǎn hé bó wù guǎn dōu shì gōng gòng zī yuán ， rèn hé rén dōu kě yǐ shǐ yòng 。
en: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

zh: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
py: wài miàn fēng dà yǔ dà ， mā mā zhǐ hǎo bǎ hái méi qián de yī fú shōu jìn lái ， guà zài wū nèi 。
en: It was raining heavily outside, and Mom had to put her clothes in and hang them in the house.

zh: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
py: qián tiān de qiáng liè tái fēng dài lái le dà yǔ ， hěn duō dì fāng dōu yān shuǐ le 。
en: The storm of the day before yesterday brought heavy rains, flooding many places.

zh: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
py: zhè gè xiāo shòu jì huà hěn hǎo ， bù guò dé xiān jiě jué xiāng guān fèi yòng hé tuī xiāo rén yuán děng xiàn shí wèn tí  A: rú guǒ xiàn zài yǒu yī qiān wàn cóng tiān shàng diào xià lái ， nà gāi duō hǎo a ！ B: nǐ bié zài zuò mèng le ， gǎn kuài huí dào xiàn shí ba ！
en: The marketing plan is good, but we have to deal with real problems like fees and salesmen.  A: If 10 million people fall out of the sky now, it would be great! B: Stop dreaming and get back to reality!

zh: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
py: ā yí de hūn lǐ míng tiān xià wǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiào táng jǔ xíng ， zhè gè zhòng yào shí kè wǒ yí dìng bù néng chí dào 。
en: Auntie's wedding is at the church tomorrow at 2 p.m. I must not be late for this important moment.

zh: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
py: lín jū yǒu jí shì dé chū mén chù lǐ ， qǐng wǒ zàn shí bāng tā zhào gù hái zi 。
en: The neighbor has an emergency to attend to and ask me to help him take care of the children for a while.

zh: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
py: tā bǎ cún le bàn bèi zi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēng yì ， jié guǒ shēng yì bù chéng gōng ， qián dōu méi le 。
en: He spent half his life in business, and the business didn't work out and the money went out.

zh: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
py: zài guó wài gōng zuò de nà jǐ nián ， tā xué huì le shén me wèn tí dōu zì jǐ jiě jué ， bù yī kào bié rén 。
en: In the years when he worked abroad, he learned to solve all his problems on his own, without relying on anyone else.

zh: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
py: miàn shì shí bì xū chuān zhèng shì de fú zhuāng ， gēn lǎo bǎn duì huà shí ， yě yīng biǎo xiàn chū kè qì 、  qiān xū de tài dù 。
en: The interview must be in a formal dress, and when talking to the boss, it should be polite and modest.

zh: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
py: wèi le bì miǎn ér tóng fā shēng yì wài ， jiā zhǎng zài lóu tī biān zhuāng le ān quán wǎng 。
en: In order to avoid accidents among children, the parents installed a safety net along the stairs.

zh: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
py: nà gè měi guó rén měi tiān kàn tái wān de lián xù jù ， yì fāng miàn xué xí zhōng wén ， yì fāng miàn liǎo jiě tái wān de shēng huó wén huà 。
en: The American watched a series of dramas in Taiwan every day, learning Chinese while learning Taiwan's culture of life.

zh: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
py: zhǐ yào dǎ kāi shǒu jī ， lián shàng wǎng lù ， jiù néng lì kè zhǎng wò quán qiú xīn wén 。
en: If you turn on your cell phone and connect to the Internet, you can get the global news right away.

zh: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
py: A: gōng sī cóng míng tiān qǐ jiù bù zài tí gōng miǎn fèi de sān cān le 。 B: zhè me zhòng dà de jué dìng ， wèi shén me xiàn zài cái tōng zhī wǒ men ？
en: A: The company no longer provides free meals for three meals from tomorrow. B: Why are we informed of such a big decision now?

zh: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
