en: Miss Wendice gave a box of chocolate to her lover on White Valentine's Day.

zh: 老闆為了感謝員工為公司付出這麼多，決定親手做菜請大家吃。
py: lǎo bǎn wèi le gǎn xiè yuán gōng wèi gōng sī fù chū zhè me duō ， jué dìng qīn shǒu zuò cài qǐng dà jiā chī 。
en: In order to thank the employees for paying so much for the company, the boss decided to cook with his own hands.

zh: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
py: zhàn zài lǎo bǎn bèi hòu de nà gè rén yǐ jīng tōng guò le miàn shì ， míng tiān jiù yào lái shàng bān le  「 měi gè chéng gōng nán rén de bèi hòu ， dōu yǒu yī gè wěi dà de nǚ rén 。」 nǐ jué dé zhè jù huà yǒu dào lǐ ma ？
en: The man standing behind the boss has passed the interview and he's coming to work tomorrow. "Every successful man has a great woman behind his back." Do you think that makes sense?

zh: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
py: kè rén kàn le nà jiàn yáng zhuāng yī yǎn jiù zǒu le ， yīng gāi bù xǐ huān ba 。
en: The guests just looked at the dress and left. I don't think they like it.

zh: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
py: gēn dà rén bǐ qǐ lái ， xiǎo hái zi de xiǎng fǎ bǐ jiào dān chún 、 tiān zhēn ， bù huì gù yì piàn rén  A: wǎng yǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián ， shuō tā de jiā rén shēng bìng zhù yuàn le 。 B: nǐ tài tiān zhēn le ， tā shì piàn nǐ de 。
en: The idea of a child is purer and more naive than a grown-up. He doesn't mean to deceive  A: Internet users borrow me $100,000 to say that his family is in hospital sick. B: You're too naive, he's lying to you.

zh: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
py: tīng shuō tiān shàng de yī tiān ， chà bu duō shì rén jiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián   zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng měi jí le ， hǎo xiàng rén jiān tiān táng yī yàng 。
en: It's been said that a day in the sky, it's been almost 10 years, and the view here is beautiful, like a paradise.

zh: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
py: huá rén zài chú xī nà tiān ， dōu yào huí dào fù mǔ shēn biān ， quán jiā jù zài yì qǐ chī nián yè fàn 。
en: And on the day of the New Year's Eve, the people of the city will return to their parents, and all their families will be gathered together for annual dinner.

zh: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
py: hái zi shì fù mǔ zuì zhēn guì de bǎo bèi ， fù mǔ duì tā men de ài yě shì zuì zhēn shí de   xiǎo wén fáng nèi de guì zi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎo bèi ， dōu shì tā shàng shān xià hǎi dài huí lái de jì niàn pǐn 。
en: Children are the most precious babies of their parents, and their love for them is also the most true of the boxes in the `br' penthouse, and they are the souvenirs he brought back from the mountains and the sea.

zh: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
py: xiǎng dāng nián ， chū guó liú xué de rì zi suī rán hěn máng ， què hěn chōng shí   suàn suàn rì zi ， shèng xià liǎng gè xīng qī jīng lǐ jiù yào tuì xiū le   míng tiān shì wǒ fù mǔ jié hūn sān shí nián de zhòng yào rì zi ， yí dìng yào hǎo hǎo dì qìng zhù 。
en: In that year, the days of study abroad were busy, but they were full of money, and the manager was due to retire for two weeks. Tomorrow was the 30th anniversary of my parents' marriage and must be celebrated.

zh: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
py: jǐng chá zhuā dào xiǎo tōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dài dào jǐng chá jú ， guān le qǐ lái 。
en: When the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

zh: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
py: mā mā shí zài tài huì zuò fàn le ， zhǐ yòng le yī gè xiǎo shí jiù biàn chū yī zhuō jì fēng fù yòu hǎo chī de dà cān 。
en: Mom's really good at cooking, and it's only an hour before she gets a big, rich and delicious meal.

zh: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
py: rú guǒ tóng shì zhī jiān bù yuàn yì gōu tōng ， zhè gè huì yì zěn me kāi xià qù ne ？
en: If colleagues don't want to talk to each other, how do we keep this meeting going?

zh: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
py: wài guó rén zài tái wān shēng huó qī jiān ， rú guǒ yù dào rèn hé wèn tí ， dōu kě yǐ dǎ 0800-024111， qǐng qiú xié zhù   nà gè huài rén shā le rén ， tā zhī dào zì jǐ cuò le ， dào jiào táng qù qǐng qiú shàng dì yuán liàng 。
en: During his life in Taiwan, a foreigner can call 0800-024111 if he encounters any problems, and ask for help in the murder of the bad man who knows he was wrong and asks for God's forgiveness in the church.

zh: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
py: zhāng lǎo shī rèn zhēn guān chá xué shēng men de biǎo xiàn ， zhè yàng cái néng liǎo jiě tā men de xīn lǐ hé xué xí qíng kuàng 。
en: Teacher Zhang carefully observed the students' performance in order to understand their psychology and learning.

zh: 每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
py: měi nián nóng lì yí yuè chū yī shì huá rén xīn nián de dì yī tiān   wǒ fù mǔ měi gè yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ ， dàn wǒ zǒng shì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le 。
en: Every year the first day of the first month of the agricultural calendar is the first day of the Chinese New Year   my parents send me money at the beginning of the month, but I always spend all the money in the middle of the month.

zh: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
py: zhè zuò dǎo de fēng jǐng hěn měi ， lǚ guǎn jià gé yě hěn hé lǐ ， nán guài bù shǎo yóu kè nián nián dōu lái zhè lǐ lǚ xíng 。
en: The view of the island is beautiful and the hotel price is reasonable, so no wonder a lot of tourists travel here every year.

zh: 他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。
py: tā nǔ lì le sān nián ， zhōng yú kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de dà xué ， tā jī dòng dé liú xià le yǎn lèi 。
en: After three years of trying, he finally got into the best college, and he started to cry.

zh: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
py: xìng kuī nǐ lái bāng máng ， yào bù rán wǒ yī gè rén jué duì máng bù guò lái   xìng kuī wǒ bǎ zī liào dōu cún zài yún duān ， yào bù rán zhǎo bú dào suí shēn dié ， zěn me kāi huì ne ？
en: Thank God you're here to help me, or I'm not going to be able to make it on my own. How else can I get a meeting if I can't find the disk?

zh: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
py: rén de yī shēng zhǐ yǒu duǎn duǎn jǐ shí nián ， yīng gāi bǎ wò shí jiān ， ràng shēng huó guò dé chōng shí 、  kuài lè 。
en: A man's life is only a few decades short, and he should have time to live a full and happy life.

zh: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
py: nà bù diàn yǐng méi yǒu jié jú ， shì dǎo yǎn yào liú gěi guān zhòng xiǎng xiàng de kōng jiān 。
en: There was no end to the film, and it was the space the director wanted to leave for viewers to imagine.

zh: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
py: měi gè mín zú dōu yǒu zì jǐ dú tè de xí sú ， xiàng huá rén chú xī tiē chūn lián 、 nián yè fàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tè bié 。
en: Every people has its own special habits, like Chinese New Year's Eve, and the fish of the year can't eat them all.

zh: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
py: wǒ men zài shān shàng ná zhù shè yǐng jī ， děng zhù tài yáng shēng qǐ ， bǎ měi lì de rì chū shí kè lù xià lái 。
en: We've got cameras in the mountains, waiting for the sun to rise, recording the beautiful sunrise.

zh: 母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
py: mǔ qīn wèi jiā rén qīn shǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máo yī ， xī wàng ràng dà jiā guò gè wēn nuǎn de dōng tiān 。
en: Mother has made her own sweaters for her family in the hope of a warm winter.

zh: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
py: zhè bù ài qíng diàn yǐng shì gēn jù zhēn shí gù shì pāi chū lái de ， kàn guò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎn jué 。
en: This love film is based on the real story, and it's very emotional for everyone to see.

zh: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī chū bǎn de xiǎo shuō ， péi zhù bù shǎo dú zhě yī kuài ér chéng zhǎng ， yě dài gěi tā men wú qióng de lè qù 。
en: This company publishes novels that grow up with a lot of readers and give them a lot of fun.

zh: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
py: zài zhēn shí shì jiè zhōng méi yǒu 「 lóng 」 zhè zhǒng dòng wù ， nà zhǐ shì gǔ rén de xiǎng xiàng 。
en: There's no such animal in the real world, it's an ancient imagination.

zh: 按照華人的習俗，紅包裡面的錢不可以是四百、四千等等。
py: àn zhào huá rén de xí sú ， hóng bāo lǐ miàn de qián bù kě yǐ shì sì bǎi 、 sì qiān děng děng 。
en: According to Chinese custom, the money in the red bag can't be 400, 4,000, etc.

zh: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
py: wǒ nán péng yǒu qīn shǒu zuò le yī zhāng kǎ piàn ， hái mǎi le yī gè piào liàng de bēi bāo sòng gěi wǒ ，  tā de xīn yì ràng wǒ hěn gǎn dòng 。
en: My boyfriend made a card and bought me a beautiful backpack, and I was touched by his feelings.

zh: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
py: zǒng tǒng chù lǐ rèn hé wèn tí shí ， zuì xiān xiǎng dào de yīng gāi shì guó jiā de lì yì ， bú shì gè rén de lì yì 。
en: When the President deals with any issue, the first thought should be in the interest of the State, not in the interest of the individual.

zh: 付完學費，我的獎學金只剩下三千塊，這個月只有吃饅頭過日子了。
py: fù wán xué fèi ， wǒ de jiǎng xué jīn zhǐ shèng xià sān qiān kuài ， zhè gè yuè zhǐ yǒu chī mán tóu guò rì zi le 。
en: After school fees, I've only got $3,000 in my scholarship, and this month I'm going to have to eat and live.

zh: 做好環境保護的工作，是每個現代人應盡的責任。
py: zuò hǎo huán jìng bǎo hù de gōng zuò ， shì měi gè xiàn dài rén yīng jǐn de zé rèn 。
en: Good environmental protection is the responsibility of every modern human being.

zh: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
py: wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎo juàn dōu huì zǎi xì jiǎn chá yī biàn ， yào shì fā xiàn cuò wù jiù mǎ shàng gǎi guò lái   fèi tài tài jié hūn hòu cái fā xiàn zhè shì gè cuò wù jué dìng ， tā bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn cái hǎo 。
en: Every time I finish my exam, I check it out, and if I find a mistake, I'll change it to Mrs.   when she gets married. She doesn't know what to do.

zh: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
py: yǒu shí hòu hái zi bù míng bái zì jǐ dào dǐ fàn le shén me cuò ， fù mǔ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo gēn tā men gōu tōng 。
en: Sometimes children don't understand what they're doing, and parents should talk to them.

zh: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
py: tiān qì biàn liáng le ， nǎi nǎi tóu tòng de máo bìng yòu fàn le 。
en: It's getting cold and Grandma's headaches are getting worse.

zh: A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。
py: A: fàn cuò de rén dōu kě yǐ qǐng qiú yuán liàng ma ？ B: dé kàn tā fàn de shì shén me cuò ， yào shì xiǎo xiǎo de cuò ， jiù gāi yuán liàng ba 。
en: A: Can anyone who makes a mistake ask forgiveness? B: It depends on what he does, and if it is a small mistake, forgive.

zh: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
py: A: wǒ duì hé xiǎo jiě shì zhēn xīn de ， wèi shén me tā yì zhí bù kěn jiē shòu ne ？ B: nǐ yīng gāi gèng guān xīn tā 、 gèng tǐ tiē tā ， ràng tā zhī dào nǐ shì zhēn xīn ài tā de 。
en: A: I am sincere to Miss Ho, why has she not accepted? B: You should have been more concerned with her, more attentive to her, so that she could know that you truly loved her.

zh: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
py: tiān shàng yǒu wú shù gè xīng xīng ， jù zài yì qǐ jiù biàn chéng le měi lì de yín hé 。
en: There are many stars in the sky, and when they gather together, they become beautiful Milky Way.

zh: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
py: xiǎo zhāng xǐ huān yuè dú fǎ guó de wén xué zuò pǐn ， tòu guò zhè xiē zuò pǐn ， ràng tā liǎo jiě le fǎ guó wén huà de tè sè 。
en: Jang likes to read French literature, which gives him an idea of the characteristics of French culture.

zh: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
py: yì xiān shēng duì xì jù yǒu hěn dà de xìng qù ， xiǎo shí hòu de mèng xiǎng jiù shì dāng yī míng chéng gōng de yǎn yuán 。
en: Mr. Yee was very interested in theatre, and the dream of childhood was to be a successful actor.

zh: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
py: rú xiǎng tōng guò nà jiā qǐ yè de miàn shì ， jiù dé xiān shú xī tā men de chǎn pǐn tè sè yǔ xiāo shòu fāng shì 。
en: If you want to go through the interview with the company, you need to be familiar with the characteristics of their products and the way they are sold.

zh: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
py: yán jiào shòu duì hàn yǔ yǔ fǎ yǒu hěn shēn rù de yán jiū ， nán guài tā de yǔ fǎ kè nà me shòu huān yíng 。
en: Professor Kuan has an in-depth study of Chinese grammar, which is why his grammar class is so popular.

zh: 這座古蹟已經有兩百多年的歷史。
py: zhè zuò gǔ jī yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng bǎi duō nián de lì shǐ 。
en: It's been over 200 years.

zh: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
py: zhè cì huì yì de zhǔ tí gēn xiāo shòu xīn chǎn pǐn yǒu guān ， suǒ yǐ guǎng gào bù mén de rén yuán dé cān jiā 。
en: The topic of the meeting was related to the sale of new products, so members of the advertising department had to attend.

zh: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
py: 《 shēng rì kuài lè 》 shì quán shì jiè zhù míng de gē qǔ ， bù tóng guó jiā de rén yě néng yòng zì jǐ de yǔ yán chàng chū lái 。
en: Happy Birthday is a world-famous song that people from different countries can sing in their own language.

zh: 這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。
py: zhè zuò gǔ lǎo de chéng shì yīn wèi gōng gòng shè bèi tài jiù ， gòu wù yě bù fāng biàn ， bù shǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le 。
en: This old city has moved many people because public equipment is too old and shopping is not easy.

zh: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
py: xué xiào gài le yī dòng huó dòng zhōng xīn ， xué shēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāo liú 、 xiū xián de hǎo chǎng suǒ le 。
en: The school built an activity centre, and the students added a good place to communicate and rest.

zh: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
py: zhè zhī shǒu biǎo shì wǒ guò shì de yé yé liú gěi wǒ de ， duì wǒ lái shuō jù yǒu tè bié de yì yì   wǒ de lǎo bǎn jù yǒu dú tè de lǐng dǎo mèi lì ，  yuán gōng dōu yuàn yì gēn zhù tā nǔ lì gōng zuò 。
en: This watch was left to me by my late grandfather, and it meant so much to me that my boss was uniquely placed to lead, and all the employees were willing to work with him.

zh: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
py: guó jiā gēn guó jiā zhī jiān de wài jiāo guān xì hěn zhòng yào ， zhè fāng miàn de gōng zuò shì zǒng tǒng fù zé de 。
en: The diplomatic relationship between the state and the state is important, and the President is responsible for this.

zh: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
py: kāng xiān shēng bǎ zhè kuài mù tóu kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo ， zhè gè yì shù zuò pǐn wán chéng hòu ， hái néng fàng zài měi shù guǎn ne ！
en: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird, and when it's finished, it'll still be in the museum!

zh: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
py: zhè zuò chéng shì bù dàn jiāo tōng shí fēn biàn lì ， shēng huó shuǐ zhǔn yě hěn gāo ， dà jiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhè lǐ zhù 。
en: The city is not only accessible but also very well-off, and everyone wants to move in here.

zh: 那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。
py: nà wèi huà jiā de zuò pǐn shí fēn shēng dòng ， huà lǐ de rén wù hǎo xiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chū lái yī yàng 。
en: The painter's work was very lively, and the characters in it really seemed to be able to come out of it.

zh: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
py: xià tiān de yè wǎn ， zài yuàn zi lǐ chuī zhù liáng kuài de fēng ， xīn shǎng tiān kōng měi lì de xīng xīng ，  jiǎn zhí jiù xiàng zài tiān táng yī yàng 。
en: In summer nights, blowing a cool wind in the yard, looking at beautiful stars in the sky, it's like heaven.

zh: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
py: yǒu rén shè jì chū dì zhèn de jǐng gào xì tǒng ， jiǎn shǎo le dì zhèn dài lái de shāng hài ， zhè yàng de chéng jiù zhēn shì liǎo bù qǐ 。
en: An impressive achievement was the design of an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by the earthquake.

zh: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
py: zhāng xiān shēng fū fù zì cóng jié hūn yǐ lái ， bù céng chǎo guò jià ， yīn wèi liǎng rén de pí qì dōu tài hǎo le 。
en: Mr. and Mrs. Zhang have not had a quarrel since their marriage, because they are both very good tempers.

zh: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
py: yī dà zǎo jiù yǒu bù shǎo mín zhòng zài sì miào qián de guǎng chǎng shàng yùn dòng 。
en: In the early hours of the day, many people were playing in squares in front of the temple.

zh: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
py: nà dòng gōng yù zì cóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dà huǒ zhī hòu ， jiù bù shì hé jū zhù le 。
en: The apartment had not been suitable for residence since a fire three years earlier.

zh: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
py: bù shǎo bó wù guǎn lǐ de yì shù pǐn dōu shì cóng gǔ dài bǎo liú dào xiàn dài de ， jù yǒu zhòng yào de shí dài yì yì 。
en: Many of the art in museums are preserved from ancient times to modern times and of great contemporary significance.

zh: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
py: měi gè mín zú dōu yǒu zì jǐ de yǔ yán hé wén zì ， yě yòng tā men lái jì lù lì shǐ 。
en: Every nation has its own language and words, and they are used to record history.

zh: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
py: hái zi shì fù mǔ zuì qīn ài de bǎo bèi ， fù mǔ duì tā men de ài shì méi bàn fǎ yòng wén zì lái xíng róng de 。
en: Children are the dearest of parents, and their love cannot be described in words.

zh: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
py: zǐ zǐ yǒu le zì jǐ de hái zi yǐ hòu ， cái tǐ huì dào dāng fù mǔ shì hěn xīn kǔ de 。
en: It's hard for a sister to be a parent when she has a child of her own.

zh: 在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。
py: zài huá rén shè huì zhōng ，「 lóng 」 jù yǒu zhòng yào de wén huà yì yì ， dàn 「 lóng 」 qí shí shì bù cún zài de 。
en: In Chinese society, dragons have important cultural significance, but dragons do not exist.

zh: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
py: bó wù guǎn lǐ de dōng xī fēi cháng bǎo guì ，  tā men jù yǒu mín zú hé wén huà de jià zhí ，  méi bàn fǎ yòng qián suàn qīng chǔ de   měi gè rén de shēng mìng jià zhí dōu shì yī yàng de ， bù yīng gāi wèi le zì jǐ de lì yì ér xī shēng bié rén 。
en: The things in the museum are very precious, they are of national and cultural value, they can't calculate with money that every human life is worth the same, and they shouldn't sacrifice others for their own good.

zh: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
py: wǒ bó bo zài xiāng xià yǒu yī kuài tǔ dì ， kě shì dì diǎn hěn piān pì ， xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào 。
en: My uncle has a piece of land in the country, but it's very remote and can't be sold if he wants to.

zh: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
py: xiǎo tōu ： wǒ yòu méi tōu dōng xī ， wèi shén me zhuā wǒ ？  jǐng chá ： nǐ xiān bié dòng ， zhǐ yào kàn le shāng diàn shè yǐng jī lù xià lái de nèi róng ， jiù zhī dào shì shí le 。
en: Thieves: I didn't steal anything, why did I get caught? Police: You just stay still, just look at what's on the store camera, and you'll know the truth.

zh: 王老先生年輕時就離開了家鄉，他很想回老家去看看親人。
py: wáng lǎo xiān shēng nián qīng shí jiù lí kāi le jiā xiāng ， tā hěn xiǎng huí lǎo jiā qù kàn kàn qīn rén 。
en: Mr. Wang left his home when he was young and wanted to go home and see his family.

zh: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
py: shàng cì wǒ chū guó lǚ xíng shí ， hù zhào bèi tōu le ， xìng hǎo dǎo yóu tōng zhī le dāng dì de wài jiāo rén yuán ， hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hù zhào 。
en: Last time I was travelling abroad, my passport was stolen, and fortunately the guide informed the local diplomats, and the new passport was soon completed.

zh: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
py: A: nǐ shuō lǎo bǎn xià gè yuè yào tí gāo měi gè rén de xīn shuǐ ， méi piàn wǒ ba ？ B: zhè gè xiāo xī shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chū lái de ， dāng rán shì zhēn de 。
en: A: You lied to me when you said your boss was going to raise everyone's salary next month? B: The news came out of his mouth, of course it was true.

zh: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。

en: The mango ice in Taiwan is so delicious that even the foreigners who ate it were very happy  A: This year's sales were worse than ever, and everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You're my best friend, and even you think so, I have nothing to say.

zh: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
py: wǒ de lì shǐ zuò yè xiě wán le ， tóng shí yě bǎ míng tiān yào bào gào de gǔ jī zī liào zhǔn bèi hǎo le 。
en: I've finished my work in history, and at the same time I've prepared the ancients to be reported tomorrow.

zh: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
py: rén lèi de zhì huì biǎo xiàn zài sī kǎo 、 gōu tōng 、 xīn shǎng 、 chuàng zào děng fāng miàn 。
en: Human wisdom manifests itself in thinking, communicating, appreciating, creating.

zh: 王教授有一本古書，那本書已經有幾百年的歷史了。
py: wáng jiào shòu yǒu yī běn gǔ shū ， nà běn shū yǐ jīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lì shǐ le 。
en: Professor Wang has an ancient book that is centuries old.

zh: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
py: yǒu rén yǐ wèi shēn tǐ méi shén me máo bìng jiù dài biǎo hěn jiàn kāng ， zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ shì shí shàng bù wán quán zhèng què 。
en: It is not entirely correct to think that there is nothing wrong with the body and that it is healthy.

zh: 這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。
py: zhè běn shū yǒu fēng fù de nèi róng jí shēng dòng de qiān bǐ huà ， shì xī yǐn dú zhě gòu mǎi de zhǔ yào yuán yīn 。
en: This book, which is rich in content and lively pencils, is the main reason for attracting readers to buy it.

zh: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
py: jué dà bù fèn de huá rén dōu hěn zhòng shì chūn jié ， suǒ yǐ huí jiā tuán yuán 、 hù xiāng bài nián ， tā men rèn wèi dōu shì gāi zuò de 。
en: Most Chinese people look at the festival, so they come home and pray for each other, and they think it's all right to do it.

zh: 看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。
py: kàn diàn yǐng shí ， rú guǒ yào zàn shí lí kāi zuò wèi ， jì dé bǎ zhòng yào wù pǐn dài zài shēn shàng 。
en: When watching a movie, if you want to leave your seat temporarily, take important items with you.

zh: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
py: zhǐ yǒu tú huà ， méi yǒu wén zì de gù shì shū  ， néng gòu liú gěi ér tóng xiǎng xiàng jí sī kǎo de kōng jiān 。
en: Only drawings, stories without words, leave space for children to imagine and think.

zh: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
py: jīn tiān shàng wǔ xué xiào fù jìn fā shēng le chē huò ， jīng guò jǐng chá chù lǐ hòu ， xiàn zài jiāo tōng yǐ huī fù zhèng cháng 。
en: There was a car accident near the school this morning, and now traffic is back to normal after the police took care of it.

zh: 這是我和你之間的祕密，你絕對不可告訴別人。
py: zhè shì wǒ hé nǐ zhī jiān de mì mì ， nǐ jué duì bù kě gào sù bié rén 。
en: It's a secret between you and me. You must never tell anyone.

zh: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
py: yào wéi chí shè qū liáng hǎo de shēng huó pǐn zhì ， jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lā jī 、 jiǎn shǎo jiā tíng zào yīn zuò qǐ 。
en: In order to maintain the good quality of life in the community, it is important to start without littering and reducing household noise.

zh: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
py: bà bà cháng jiào dǎo wǒ zuò rén yào qiān xū ， tài jiāo ào de huà ， bù jǐn ràng rén tǎo yàn ， zuò shì yě kě néng bù shùn lì 。
en: My father taught me to be modest, to be too proud, not only to be disgusting, but to do things badly.

zh: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
py: gǔ xiǎo jiě zuò shì de tài dù hěn jī jí ， wèi le wán chéng rèn wù ， zǒng shì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jì huà ， ér qiě lì kè shí xíng 。
en: Ms. Gu's attitude is very positive, and in order to accomplish her task, she always plans well in advance and does so immediately.

zh: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
py: yīn wèi xué xiào quē fá jīng fèi ， sù shè de diàn nǎo shè bèi zàn shí méi bàn fǎ gǎi shàn 。
en: The computer infrastructure of the dormitories cannot be improved for the time being due to the lack of school fees.

zh: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
py: tā wèi le yǎn hǎo jiàn shēn jiào liàn de jué sè ， tòu guò yùn dòng yǔ diào zhěng yǐn shí ， ràng shēn tǐ wéi chí zài zuì jiā de zhuàng tài 。
en: In order to perform his role as a fitness coach, he was able to maintain his body in the best possible state by exercising and adjusting his diet.

zh: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
py: xiǎng yào ràng shēn tǐ jiàn kāng ， dé xiān zhù yì yǐn shí ， shǎo chī tài yóu 、 tài xián de shí wù ； qí cì yào péi yǎng měi tiān yùn dòng de hǎo xí guàn 。
en: In order to be healthy, attention must be given to drinking and eating less oily, too salty food; its secondary aspect is to nurture the good habits of daily sports.

zh: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
py: wèi le tí gāo zhè zuò chéng shì de wén huà shuǐ zhǔn ， shì zhǎng jī jí jiàn shè yì shù biǎo yǎn zhōng xīn 、 tú shū guǎn děng gōng gòng kōng jiān   xiàng jī chǎng 、 gāo tiě 、 jié yùn zhè lèi gōng gòng jiāo tōng jiàn shè ， dōu xū yào hěn duō jīng fèi cái néng wán chéng 。
en: In order to improve the cultural standards of the city, the mayor has been very active in building public spaces such as ‘br’ airports, high-speed railways, and other public transport facilities such as art performance centres, libraries, etc.

zh: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
py: zhè zuò dì xià tíng chē chǎng yīn wèi quē fá jīng fèi ， méi bàn fǎ gǎi shàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíng xíng 。
en: The underground parking park was unable to improve its darkness due to lack of funds.

zh: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
py: yīn wèi qiáng liè tái fēng de guān xì ， jī chǎng yǐ jīng guān le ， děng fēng xiǎo yī diǎn cái huì zài kāi fàng 。
en: Because of the storm, the airport is closed until the wind is smaller.

zh: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
py: (1)  bù shǎo wài guó rén shuō zhōng wén bù róng yì xué ， chú le hàn zì nán xiě ， shēng diào 、 yǔ fǎ yě hěn nán 。 xiǎng bǎ zhōng wén xué hǎo ， zǒng ér yán zhī jiù shì duō tīng 、 duō shuō 、 duō liàn xí 。
en: (1) Chinese is not easy to learn in many foreign countries, except for Chinese. It is difficult to speak and to use grammar.

py: A: wǒ dào dǐ gāi zěn me zuò cái néng ràng lǎo bǎn mǎn yì ？ B: nǐ tài jiāo ào 、 gè xìng tài jí ，  zuò shì yě bù gòu zǎi xì 。 zǒng zhī ，  xiān bǎ zì jǐ de quē diǎn gǎi diào ba 。
en: A: What am I supposed to do to make my boss happy? B: You're too proud, you're too desperate, you don't do enough. Anyway, just get rid of your flaws.

zh: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
py: zhè kè de hàn zì wǒ dōu rèn dé ， dàn hái bù tài huì xiě ， suǒ yǐ bǐ shì shí hǎo xiē zì dōu xiě cuò le   dì di ： yé yé zěn me cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míng zì gǎo cuò ？  gē gē ： yé yé nián jì tài dà le ， nǎo zi bù qīng chǔ ， hǎo xiàng bù rèn dé wǒ men le 。

en: It's a world puzzle that's hard to spell, and it's gonna take days to do it.

zh: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。

zh: 這本小說介紹了許多中國的古人古事，內容既豐富又有趣。

en: This novel, which presents many ancient Chinese stories, is rich and interesting.

zh: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。

en: The brother went to the supermarket to buy a bag of corn and two buns of bread for dinner for his family.

zh: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。

en: The soldiers who came to the earthquake-affected areas were too busy to eat a meal in those days.

zh: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。

en: Ann had a doll face and was treated everywhere as a college student who knew he was 40 years old.

zh: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。

en: No one can tell you what life means, but they can find answers on their own.

en: The dream of the young year was to build a 60-story, three-story house with the entire family.

zh: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
py: gēn jù zhuān jiā de shuō fǎ ， xiǎng yào shēn tǐ jiàn kāng ， yī tiān zhì shǎo dé hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ 。
en: According to experts, to be healthy, at least five cups of water a day.

zh: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
py: lì shǐ xì de lǐ jiào shòu zuì jìn jīng cháng jiē shòu jì zhě de fǎng wèn ， yīn cǐ biàn dé hěn yǒu míng   nà míng jì zhě wèi le fǎng wèn zǒng tǒng wài jiāo 、 mào yì děng fāng miàn de wèn tí ， yuè dú le xǔ duō xiāng guān de zī liào 。
en: Professor Lee of the Department of History has recently been interviewed by journalists and has become a well-known journalist who has read a lot of relevant information in order to visit the President's diplomatic, trade and other issues.

zh: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
py: cóng liù ○ nián dài kāi shǐ ， tái wān jiù tí gōng nóng yè fāng miàn de xié zhù gěi xǔ duō guó jiā ， zhè diǎn ràng wǒ jué dé hěn jiāo ào 。
en: Since the 1960s, Taiwan has provided agricultural assistance to many countries, and I am proud of that.

zh: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
py: yǒu yī xiē yán jiū kē xué de rén ， duì bù kē xué 、 wú fǎ hé lǐ jiě shì de xiàn xiàng dōu bù tài xiāng xìn 。
en: There are some scientists who don't believe in unscientific and inexplicable situations.

zh: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
py: zuì jìn tiān qì bù tài wěn dìng ， qì wēn de biàn huà hěn dà ， chū mén shí zuì hǎo dài bǎ sǎn 。
en: The weather has been unstable lately, the temperature has changed considerably, and it is best to have an umbrella on the way out.

zh: 上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。
py: shàng dì shì bú shì cún zài ， zhè shì shǔ yú zōng jiào lǐng yù de wèn tí ， kē xué jiā de jiě shì bù yí dìng shì zhèng què de 。
en: Whether God exists or not, it's a matter of religion, and scientists don't necessarily explain it correctly.

zh: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
py: zuó tiān bàng qiú sài jìn xíng dào yí bàn shí tū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ ， suī rán hòu lái yǔ tíng le ， dàn yīn wèi qiú chǎng tài shī ， yě wú fǎ jì xù bǐ sài le 。
en: When the baseball game started in the middle of yesterday, it suddenly rained down, and it stopped, but because the field was too heavy to continue.

zh: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
py: wèi le shǐ shì qū （shìqū， urban area） de jiāo tōng gèng biàn lì ， mù qián huáng shì zhǎng zhèng jìn xíng gè zhǒng gǎi shàn jì huà 。
en: In order to make transportation easier in the city (shuyq, urban area), the Governor is currently working on various improvement projects.

zh: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
py: rén kǒu zēng jiā bù jǐn yǐng xiǎng shēng huó pǐn zhì ， kǒng pà yě huì zào chéng shí wù quē fá de wèn tí 。
en: The increase in the population affects not only the quality of life but also, I fear, the lack of food.

zh: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
py: yǐn shí yǔ jiàn kāng yǒu mì qiè de guān xì ， suǒ yǐ rén rén dōu yīng gāi àn shí chī sān cān 。
en: Eating and eating are closely linked to health, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

zh: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
py: kē xué jiā fā míng liǎo diàn dēng ， gǎi biàn le rén lèi de shēng huó fāng shì ， yě dà dà tí gāo le shēng huó pǐn zhì   wǎng lù shì hěn wěi dà de fā míng ， jiù suàn bù chū mén ， yě néng ràng rén men dé dào quán qiú gè dì de xùn xī 。
en: Scientists have invented electric lights, changed the way of life for humans, and significantly improved the quality of the `br' web, which is a great invention that, if left out, can give people access to information from around the globe.

zh: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
py: kuài shí shàng de gài niàn ， jiù shì zài duǎn shí jiān nèi tí gōng gè shì gè yàng de liú xíng shāng pǐn ， ràng gù kè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎn zé 。
en: The concept of fast-fashion is to provide a variety of popular commodities in a short period of time, giving customers more and better choices.

zh: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
py: kē xué jiā zǎo jiù zhèng míng liǎo qì wēn de biàn huà duì nóng yè shēng chǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐng xiǎng ， kě shì dào mù qián hái zhǎo bú dào jiě jué de hǎo bàn fǎ 。
en: Scientists have long proven that changes in temperature have had a negative impact on agricultural production, but there is still no good solution.

zh: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
py: xiǎng yào shēn tǐ jiàn kāng ， zuì yǒu xiào de fāng fǎ jiù shì duō yùn dòng 、 shǎo chī tián diǎn 、 duō chī shū cài shuǐ guǒ 。
en: The most effective way to be healthy is to exercise more, to eat less dessert and to eat more vegetables and fruits.

zh: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
py: nà gè xiǎo tōu chèn zhù guān zhòng kàn biǎo yǎn de shí hòu tōu dōng xī ， jié guǒ dāng chǎng jiù bèi ān quán rén yuán zhuā le 。
en: The thief stole while the audience was watching the performance, and the security officers caught him on the spot.

zh: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
py: yīn wèi bīng xiāng huài le ， lǐ miàn de shí wù chú le jī dàn 、 píng guǒ ， qí tā de dōu fǔ bài le 。
en: Because the fridge is broken, the food in it is corrupted except eggs and apples.

zh: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
py: zhè tiáo lù bù píng ， yǒu mín zhòng tiē le hǎi bào ， qǐng dà jiā zǒu lù shí yào xiǎo xīn ， yǐ miǎn shòu shāng 。
en: The road was not peaceful, and the people put posters on them, so be careful when you walk, lest you be hurt.

zh: 王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
py: wáng bó bo zuì jìn hěn dé yì ， dào chù gào sù lín jū tā ér zi kǎo shàng le quán guó zuì yǒu míng de dà xué 。
en: Uncle Wang has recently been proud to tell his neighbours that his son has gone to the most famous university in the country.

zh: 使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。
py: shǐ yòng dì qiú zī yuán hé bǎo hù dì qiú huán jìng shì xiāng duì de ， zī yuán shǐ yòng dé yuè duō ， huán jìng jiù yuè xū yào bèi bǎo hù 。
en: The more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected.

zh: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
py: lù biān de shè yǐng jī lù dào le fáng xiān shēng fā shēng chē huò de jīng guò ， ràng jǐng chá shùn lì zhuā dào le hài tā shòu shāng de rén 。
en: The roadside camera recorded Mr. Houseman's car accident, which led the police to arrest the person who had injured him.

zh: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
py: wáng xiān shēng tóu zī shēng yì de yǎn guāng hěn hǎo ， ràng tā jǐn jǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dà lóu 。
en: Mr. Wang's vision of investing in the business is good, allowing him to buy several buildings in just one year.

zh: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
py: dāng lín jū shēng huó yù dào kùn nán shí ， lǎo mǎ zǒng shì zhǔ dòng tí gōng xié zhù ， zhēn lìng rén gǎn dòng 。
en: It is moving that when neighbours live in difficult circumstances, the old horse always offers assistance.

zh: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
py: xiàng shí wù yín xíng 、 ài xīn bīng xiāng cǐ lèi chù lǐ shí wù de zuò fǎ ， bù dàn kě yǐ jié shěng zī yuán ， hái néng bāng zhù xū yào de rén 。
en: Food-processing practices such as food banks, sweet refrigerators, etc., not only save resources, but also help people in need.

zh: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
py: jǐn guǎn zhè cì tuī xiāo xīn chǎn pǐn de huó dòng bàn dé hěn shùn lì ， gù kè de fǎn yīng yě hěn hǎo ， bù guò hái shì yǒu xū yào gǎi jìn de dì fāng 。
en: Although the marketing of new products went well and customers responded well, there is still room for improvement.

zh: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
py: yóu yú yún duān kē jì de jìn bù ， rén lèi de shēng huó fāng shì gēn yǐ wǎng bǐ qǐ lái yǒu hěn dà de chà yì 。
en: As a result of advances in cloud technology, the way of life of humans is very different from what it used to be.

zh: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
py: lián jǐng chá dōu zhèng míng zhè gè chē huò shì duàn lǎo bǎn hē zuì zào chéng de ， kě shì tā réng rán bù kěn chéng rèn 。
en: Even the police proved that the accident had been caused by the drunkenness of the boss, but he still refused to admit it.

zh: 對某一些人來說，結了婚還能不能有其他情人，這是道德問題。
py: duì mǒu yī xiē rén lái shuō ， jié le hūn hái néng bù néng yǒu qí tā qíng rén ， zhè shì dào dé wèn tí 。
en: For some people, it's a moral problem to get married without having other lovers.

zh: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
py: yóu yú měi gè rén kàn shì qíng de jiǎo dù bù tóng ， suǒ yǐ dé gōu tōng cái néng bì miǎn wù huì   nà gè mó tè ér gè zi gāo 、 zhǎng dé měi ， cóng shén me jiǎo dù pāi dōu piào liàng 。
en: Because everyone looks at things from different angles, they need to communicate in order to avoid the misunderstanding that model is tall and beautiful and beautiful from all angles.

zh: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
py: měi gè rén de yī shēng dōu yīng gāi hǎo hǎo guī huà ， rì zi cái bù huì bái bái dì guò qù   dǎo yóu wàng le gēn xiǎo tāng yuē hǎo zài hóng máo chéng mén kǒu jiàn miàn ， hài tā bái （ bái ） děng le yī gè xiǎo shí 。
en: Every man's life should be well planned so that the days don't pass in vain, and he's been waiting for an hour because he forgot to meet Tommy at the gate of Red Mao City.

zh: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
py: dǎ pò nǐ men de wǎn pán shì wǒ de cuò ， wǒ huì duì zì jǐ de xíng wèi fù zé ， fù nǐ men zhè gè fèi yòng 。
en: Breaking your bowls is my fault. I'm responsible for what I did and I'm paying you for it.

zh: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
py: jīng guò fú wù rén yuán xiáng xì dì shuō míng ， shǐ de kè rén duì gōng sī de chǎn pǐn gèng liǎo jiě le 。
en: After detailed explanations by the waiter, the customers became more aware of the company's products.

zh: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
py: dà xìn jué dé zhè gè gōng sī de xīn shuǐ gēn fú lì dōu bù hǎo ， yú shì jué dìng huàn gōng zuò 。
en: He decided to change jobs because he thought the company's salaries and benefits were bad.

zh: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
py: zhōng guó nán běi fāng de yǐn shí xí guàn yǒu yī xiē chà yì ， nán fāng rén duō chī mǐ fàn ， běi fāng rén duō chī jiǎo zi 、 mán tóu děng miàn shí 。
en: There are differences in Chinese food habits between the north and the south, with the South eating more rice and the North eating more corn, such as shoals and shoals.

zh: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
py: yuán xiāo jié shí gōng yuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēng lóng ， gè zhǒng yán sè de dēng guāng piào liàng jí le 。
en: During the Christmas Eve, various lights were lit in the park, and the lights were beautiful in all colours.

zh: 夏天時，在臺灣、日本、菲律賓都有颱風，這是很普遍的現象。
py: xià tiān shí ， zài tái wān 、 rì běn 、 fēi lǜ bīn dōu yǒu tái fēng ， zhè shì hěn pǔ biàn de xiàn xiàng 。
en: In summer, there were typhoons in Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines, a common phenomenon.

zh: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
py: dào dǐ shàng dì cún zài bù cún zài ， kē xué yǔ zōng jiào de guān diǎn bù tóng ， shuō fǎ yě bù yī yàng 。
en: Whether God exists or not, science and religion differ from the point of view and the way they say it.

zh: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
py: zhè liǎng jiā gōng sī zài kē jì fāng miàn hé zuò le hěn duō nián ， yě zài kē xué zá zhì shàng fā biǎo le gòng tóng de yán jiū chéng guǒ 。
en: Both companies have worked together in science and technology for many years and have published common research in scientific journals.

zh: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
py: lǐ lùn shàng ， yǒu kòng qì 、 shuǐ 、 shí wù jiù kě yǐ wéi chí shēng mìng ， dàn hái shì dé kàn shí jì de qíng kuàng   zhù míng de kē xué jiā ài yīn sī tǎn （ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein） fā míng liǎo xiāng duì lùn （Theory of Relativity）， zhè gè lǐ lùn duì hòu lái de kē xué yán jiū chǎn shēng le zhòng dà de yǐng xiǎng 。
en: The theory that air, water, food can sustain life, but it still depends on the fact that the famous scientist <br', Albert Einstein, saw n, Albert Einstein, invented the opposite theory, which has had a major impact on subsequent scientific research.

zh: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
py: xǔ duō guó jiā yīn wèi gōng yè jìn bù dé tài kuài ， fǎn ér shǐ de nóng yè màn màn bù bèi zhòng shì le 。
en: Farming is slowly being neglected in many countries because of the rapid pace of industrial progress.

zh: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
py: zài yún duān kē jì fā dá de shí dài lǐ ， rén rén dōu néng gòu tòu guò wǎng lù jiāo yǒu 、 xué xí 。
en: In the age of cloud technology, everyone is able to make friends and learn through the Internet.

zh: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
py: jīn tiān kè rén gēn zhù xiǎo wēn qù cān guān gōng chǎng ， yě shì yòng le xīn chǎn pǐn ， yī qiè ān pái dōu lìng tā shí fēn mǎn yì 。
en: Today, guests followed Wen to visit the factory and tried new products, all of which gave him great satisfaction.

zh: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
py: zhào gù hái méi chéng nián de hái zi shì fù mǔ yīng jǐn de zé rèn ， wú lùn rú hé ， jì rán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā 、 jiào dǎo tā 。
en: It is the responsibility of parents to take care of a child who is not yet an adult; in any case, since he is born, he should be raised and taught.

zh: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
py: dà jiā dōu zhī dào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēn tǐ méi yǒu hǎo chù ， dàn bù shǎo rén réng rán rú cǐ ， shèn zhì tiān tiān hē zuì   dàn shuǐ de xī yáng hěn měi ， rú cǐ de měi lì fēng jǐng ， shì yuē huì de jí jiā dì diǎn 。
en: Everyone knows that too much alcohol is not good for the body, but a lot of people still do, even when the sun is beautiful, and such a beautiful view is an excellent place to date.
